question: 10 year old, sulking and losing after a brush with first place?
description: The 10-year-old child participated in the school organized track and field competition and the first place passed by (only 0.1 seconds), after going home has been sullen, tears have been in the eyes of the spinning, but did not flow down, may I ask how I need to guide the child out of this kind of lose-lose mentality? Thank you!
keywords: Growth, Character Refinement, Personality Traits, Child Development

answers.answer_text: The phenomenon of "not being able to lose" is very common. In our lives, it seems that "not being able to lose" is often characterized as a personality problem, commonly described as low self-esteem on the one hand and high self-esteem on the other. Winning but not losing, requiring others to play the game the way they want to, or taking longer to recover from "failure" will surely undermine the child's self-confidence, emotional intelligence, popularity, problem solving and resistance to setbacks, and may develop an irritable, self-righteous, permissive, selfish character. Strictly speaking, this is not a character problem, but more like a kind of self-cognitive limitations, while related to temperament. I. "Can't afford to lose" is related to the degree of distraction and intensity of reaction in the child's temperament type. The distraction level here refers to children who cry for a long time and are hard to calm down once they get angry. Some children just cry so hard that they can't stop, which is a sign of a low level of distractibility in the temperament type. Some children are easily distracted, which would be an easily distracted child. A child with high reaction intensity will also have a stronger sense of difficulty and pain. Such children grow into adolescents and often feel frustrated and helpless in the face of many sudden pressures. There are some coping strategies for both the degree of distraction and the intensity of reaction, but of course it would be better if they are combined with the specific situation of the child.1. Be sensitive to the crying of a child who is not easily distracted, and when the child cries, get close to him, have physical contact with him, gently touch him, hug him, kiss him, don't talk at all, and reduce the intensity of the emotion.2. Adjust your own emotions, and then face the child's emotions.3. After the emotions have eased a little, distract his attention, preferably on the same thing. For example, the matter of the track and field competition, divert from winning or losing, and talk about other things about the competition. You can also give him a shot before the next race: "It doesn't matter if you win or lose, we'll go celebrate after the race." Regarding intensity of response, the child's state in the subject's description is not very intense. Reaction intensity varies greatly with the individual and may include shouting, crying, fussing, throwing things, or even hitting. We can think about taking care of the child's emotions in two ways: 1. Give the child an important reason for self-control. For example, you can say, you are getting more and more in control of your emotions, which is something that many children your age can't do Oh, I'm so proud of you! 2. Develop a sense of purpose in your child. Every time you do something, encourage your child to say what you hope to achieve in the end. After the child reaches a certain milestone, it is necessary to give timely positive feedback to encourage them to adhere to. Second, guide the child to face failure children's evaluation of their own often completely without negative aspects, they feel that they "can do everything". This is a stage in the development of children's self-perception. They don't want to lose because they don't want to break the realization that they can do anything, which is also a way of self-protection for children. We can try to respect children's cognitive limitations and accept their "can't afford to lose" behavior. Don't feel bad that your child is doing this, or you'll be competing with them. Your acceptance will be rewarded by making failure less important to them. When the child feels the frustration or anger brought about by failure, we had better give the child psychological support, and tell him, "This is not as easy as it seems, if we practice more, there may be great progress, we must know that no one will always lose, and no one will always win, losing and winning are conditional, what we have to do is to help the child one by one to develop habits that will lead to success, so that, in turn, the child will not take failure so seriously. Enable the habit of success, so that the child's attention, from the attention of the winners and losers, transferred to the attention of the specific operation, more conducive to dilute the child's emotions of failure, and promote the child's behavioral level of change. As children's self-awareness continues to improve, the child's evaluation of themselves will become more objective. Finally, when the child because of the "loss" crying or tantrums, you first embrace and touch him, look at him with a smile, don't rush to talk, quiet with him for a while. When your emotions are gone, your child can hear you when you speak. The child is an individual development, each stage will have each stage of the characteristics of the performance, you can follow its nature to cultivate, and then wait for the flowers to bloom.

Hello owner, first give you a big hug ~ Let's take a look at your question first: how to guide your child when he or she has a brush with first place? Winning or losing is something we often experience in life, but learning not to face winning or losing correctly will lead to their own has been affected by it, it is difficult to enjoy the joy of the game itself, but also will give themselves a lot of pressure, it is difficult to feel the joy of life. And children "can't afford to lose" is actually a normal psychological phenomenon. Children always hope that they can do everything to the end, so as to get the parents and the surrounding people's praise and recognition. But children's psychological age immaturity, look at the problem extreme, which requires parents to correctly guide. What should parents do? Know how to accept the child's emotions, appreciate the child's feelings children lose already hard enough, this time parents if the blame, will only make them more difficult, in the loss of hard to come out. Parents need to treat their children with empathy, let them understand: "Parents understand you, understand that it's hard for you to lose, even if you lose you're still great, parents are still proud of you." The owner can guide the child to say how he or she feels and then channel it. At the same time, we should also let the child understand that winning and losing is the norm in life, losing is not terrible, the terrible thing is to be unreasonable after losing, but also let the child learn to respect the opponent, and summarize their own shortcomings. Parents should set their own attitude Many times, children care about winning and losing, partly because of the parents' attitude and practice. Children should be treated the same when they lose or win. They should not be praised and rewarded when they win, but not positively encouraged when they lose, which will inadvertently put pressure on the child. Parents should emphasize whether the child responds positively in the process and gives his/her best, and learn to enjoy the process and look down on the results. What the child should care about is what he or she has learned this time, and whether he or she will make progress the next time he or she encounters the same problem. Lead by example, it is said that parents are the children's teachers, parents treat the attitude of winning and losing will subconsciously affect the children's attitude. When parents encounter the problem of winning or losing, they should treat it calmly, and at the same time use it to guide their children. Parents can play some games with their children and guide them through the results. If the child wins, praise him and prevent him from being too proud; if the child loses, praise him even more and let him summarize the strengths and weaknesses in himself and why his parents won, to summarize and improve. Remember, no matter what, leading by example is the best way to educate. The above is just my personal opinion, hope it can help you. Good luck~.

answers.answer_text: In the minds of many parents, children will always be children, no matter how old they are, and will always depend on them and obey them as they did when they were young. Since childhood, parents have been used to taking care of and controlling their children, arranging and making decisions for them. Therefore, even when their children grow up to be adults, parents are still unable to change their roles and accept the new image of their children, so their perception of their children is very biased, and they do not think that their children have the ability to be independent, do not believe that their children can think independently, and like them, they have a lot of insights, experience, wisdom, and thoughtfulness. In fact, this is a way for parents to fight for and maintain their image and status in front of their children and their children's attention and recognition. When children become adults, they will have an increasing distance from their parents and will gradually separate from them. This creates a sense of crisis, loss, and loss of control, and parents attempt to regain a sense of control by judging their children, devaluing their children's ideas, and dismissing their children's behaviors in an attempt to keep their children agreeing with them and obeying them. And much of the outdated knowledge and experience of the parental generation has caused them to hold a cognitive bias about things that prevents them from gaining the approval and acceptance of their children. But they themselves don't recognize what their problem is, or they don't want to admit that it's their own lack of understanding, believing that their ideas and suggestions are good for their children and for their children's good. In this process, they are carrying some negative emotions and anxiety, worrying that the child will suffer and fail, fearing that the child will make mistakes, getting angry at the child's rejection and resistance, and so on. In this case, if you try to explain, argue, or refute with them, it is actually useless. Because they closed the receiving channel a long time ago and act only on their own thoughts and emotions. And by trying to explain and argue with your mother in the hope that she can understand you, you are seeking your parents' approval and affirmation of you. There is a great expectation in your heart for your mother, to be recognized by her and to prove to her that you have grown and are capable. In communication, it is recommended to address the emotions before solving the problem. That is, first understand your mother's current emotional state and deeper thoughts, empathize with her and reassure her, affirm her value, make her feel that her children understand her and obey her, and her hostility and resistance to them will be eliminated. Then see the time to bring out your different ideas and needs, and that's when it will be easy for her to accept you. Intending to convince your parents is a difficult and even silly thing to do. If there are some things that you just can't explain or your mother can't understand and accept, then don't force her to accept them and respect her freedom. She may not be getting serious with you or seeking an answer. You can laugh and coax her a bit and things will pass. I hope my answer can give you some inspiration and help. Good luck~.

question: After surviving ten months and then quitting, now a year and a half later, how should a person face themselves?
description: I am a man, this year 25. after graduation into the manufacturing industry, the work is very easy, but because of the lack of personal communication skills do very hard. After ten months, I chose to quit my job. I forget what kind of mindset I held at the time did not tell my parents about this, they always thought I was still in the company to do a good job. I started to tell people that I would play for a while and then look for a job, but it's 2020, a year and a half into the game. I've been lying constantly during this time and panicking every time I get a call from my parents. My brain tells me I shouldn't, but my mouth can't help but tell them I'm working overtime, just got off work, and where I went with my coworkers today. Countless lies, big and small, make up my life in my parents' minds. It is now October. I don't know what I like, I don't know what I'm good at, and then I look back and realize that I can't even do sales. How should a person face themselves? Should I tell them the truth about myself? How can they accept that their son, whom they have worked so hard to raise, is cowering in a rented room like a piece of trash? I feel like my life is worthless. Please tell me what I should do.

answers.answer_text: Hello owner, I do not know what year you graduated, is counting this year has been at home for a year and a half? I want to say to the owner is that this year's epidemic on each of us are affected, if it is a year this year did not go to work, then the owner has to consider may be related to the whole environment this year, because the epidemic many people, especially just graduated not long ago, did not have a firm foothold in the industry development, it will be very easy to fluctuations, so it is possible that your anxiety, confusion, decadence is not you alone, but this post epidemic era there is a part of the group will appear psychological characteristics. Secondly, I don't know what kind of major the owner graduated from and what kind of position he did in the manufacturing industry. The owner said that lack of communication skills, is the lack of communication skills with colleagues and leaders, or lack of communication skills with customers? If it is and leadership colleagues that is the interpersonal relationship, the owner may not have been able to adapt to the social environment and school environment in the interpersonal communication difference. There is no interest in the school, more sincere between students, in the community at noon between coworkers is a competitive relationship, with the leadership is a superior-subordinate relationship, in interpersonal communication needs to have wisdom and strategy. And the lack of communication between the customer words can may be the owner of the industrial business is not adaptable, or the owner's own personality if it is introverted, the position requires extroversion, then there is a mismatch. Insufficient business capacity can be further enhanced does not necessarily have to resign, but the owner since the resignation, it shows that you are engaged in the original work very much do not like or do not adapt. In short, the owner of the current confusion, anxiety, fear and career development. You need to do a long-term career planning for your own life. Do career planning to consider the three most important three aspects: 1, interest, 2. values, 3. personality. 1. interest is the motivation for you to engage in this career, to do their own favorite interested in the work to be able to persist in the long term. The owner can perceive what career he is usually more interested in, and which kind of work he is more willing to engage in. Because you have graduated from college, your profession may be your interest, then let their own profession to play well, if you are not interested in their own profession, want to do other, then from their usual hobbies to understand their own interests, choose their own interest in the field, but to do a good job to prepare for the increase in costs, because change the industry risk 2. values, values are the core of the work, career needs to be in line with their own. Values are the core, the work we do, the occupation needs to be in line with their own internal values you will feel that it is meaningful to do this work. For example, some people feel that doctors save lives and their own values are in line with the willingness to become a doctor to pay for their youth, time, energy, and even unrequited dedication. To find their own inner core beliefs and values.3. Personality, each person's personality type is different, different personality is suitable for different occupations, extroverted emotional when doing sales, introverted thinking when doing research, extroverted intuitive when doing management, personality type is not good or bad. There is no good or bad personality type. There are corresponding personality strengths in different career fields, and you need to find a career that matches your own personality type. It is recommended that you do an mbti career personality type assessment to see which type you belong to. When you know more about your interests, values, and personality, you will have a clearer picture of yourself. You can target yourself according to the competencies you need for the career you want to pursue. Finally, to set a long-term goal or direction of life, you need to have a better understanding of themselves at the same time, you also need to understand the background of the industry, the industry's prospects for development, the industry rules and promotion mechanisms should have an understanding of the industry, do not change the industry because of the avoidance of any industry is not easy, and very often success is to simmer out.

The subject, hello ~ ~ ~ ~ I'm sorry to see you feel so confused, hug you ah ~ although I do not know about the "lack of communication skills" for you is a decision you have to leave the factor, if so, I think you insisted on a ten-month period of time is quite long, shows that you still have the potential to overcome the problem. Regarding your "forget what kind of mentality you held at that time not to talk to your parents about this matter", I personally think that you did not take the matter of resignation very seriously at that time, and you can find another job if you lost your job, but this is for the social situation in the ordinary period, and this year, when the new epidemic occurred, it was too difficult to find a job, so a lot of people lost the source of their living expenses. source of livelihood, which is something that no one expected. So these things broaden our cognition, no matter what time we should not close ourselves to receive the latest information about the outside world, but to keep practicing and learning, even if we do not know what we really want, we should try our best to create an environment where we can have contact with the society, and a job may be a feasible way to have contact with the outside world, so we may as well try more. Facing yourself may mean having the heart to take immediate action, don't run away. Of course it's up to you whether you choose to tell your parents or not, if your finances won't hold out until you find your next stable job, maybe you can consider asking your parents for help, after all, you're still young, and they'll allow you to take a break and regroup.

question: Emotional outbursts and some doubt after calming down that the outburst just happened?
description: I am 21 years old female, I have very high demands on my close people, I especially hope that they can listen to and understand what I say, if they don't trust what I say or are not very patient when I talk or don't take me seriously enough, I get very angry, and also when I do something at their request, if they are a little bit negative, sullen and silent, or talk to me in a somewhat negative way, I get very angry: why can't you understand what I say? I get very angry: why can't you understand what I'm saying? Or why can't you understand what I'm saying? /I've listened to you, and you're giving me this look? Then emotions may suddenly erupt, correcting what they say and do, especially aggrieved, unable to control tears, and then some hatred. Why are they forcing me to behave like this, when I can be nice. I always tell them that what I say is not at all what they understand, why do they always ask questions and answer questions, why don't they understand, why don't they change? Is this look and this attitude on your face something I'm doing wrong? Why are you looking at me like that? Why don't you answer me? Are you used to me crying like this? Don't you believe what I say? Why are you laughing at me when what I said is true?
keywords: Emotions, Healing Methods, Emotional Regulation, Tears of Vulnerability

answers.answer_text: Looking at your description, your parents seem to have a little narcissistic personality tendency, they have no way to understand you and empathize with your emotions, they live in the middle of their own world, resulting in your emotions not being able to be reasonably expressed and released, and over-suppressing your emotions, resulting in you either exploding into narcissistic rage, hurting others outwardly, or hurting yourself inwardly. It is recommended that you feel and express your emotions in the right way, for example, you can find a good friend to talk about it, write it out, exercise and other ways, or you can seek help from a counselor.

question: Learned helplessness, repeatedly encountering frustration in doing things and habitually choosing to avoid them?
description: Poor sleep to look at the problem of pessimism and negativity, encounter things do not feel good will continue to procrastinate until the worst results can not be avoided, intermittent to give themselves a chicken blood. Actively exercise, every once in a while (especially when the weather is particularly cold or hot) will be particularly weak, powerlessness explosion

answers.answer_text: Seeing your problems is like seeing myself. When faced with a challenge, one wants to run away. Often it is an intermittent effort. Perhaps the first thing we need to do is accept ourselves and tell ourselves, I am good enough too. What we need to do is boost our self-efficacy that we are good enough. When you have a problem, try to try some challenges, they can be small, choose some escapes, but not all of them. Choose one small habit to stick with, just one. Write down 3 of your past accomplishments. Wake up early and tell yourself our strengths. Also, everyone has a limited amount of time and energy, so we can't keep ourselves discharged all the time and need to set times for ourselves to recharge. Intermittent effort is an indication that we need to set ourselves up for recharging time. It's okay to tell yourself that it's okay to take breaks in order to make a better effort.

question: Confused in love, how do you go about resolving your inner conflicts?
description: I've always been confused about what love is, and what to do in the face of the heart of the person? Thinking a lot, too far away from each other and online dating, the other side will not be the only favor themselves, love to everything, a little extreme want to be the only one in his world, but it seems that not everyone can do this. So do not get to want to give up early, but can not give up, confused what is love, how to go to resolve their own internal conflicts, can be reckless to fall in love?

answers.answer_text: Hello, owner, we are all exploring and growing in every relationship, there are many difficulties to overcome, so it won't hurt to make yourself brave if you are sure of what you want. From your description, I can feel your confusion and entanglement about your current relationship status. On the one hand, you want the other person to love you authentically and belong to you alone; on the other hand, you will be unsure about the relationship and want to retreat and give up because you are worried about the distance and online dating. What I want to tell you is that every relationship where two people get along will encounter many problems, some of which are long distance and distance, some of which are family and financial gap, some of which are education and looks gap and so on. There won't be a relationship that is completely free of difficulties, especially when two people start to get serious about their relationship and start thinking about the future, the problems become more numerous, but the reason why everyone chooses to go on is pretty much the same, i.e., they love each other deeply. If they have to endure some difficulties and pain, they will choose to face them with the person they love and the person who loves them. Analyze your heart clearly, you can see that you are more like each other, and learn to express your needs. If you want the other person to care more about you some, more considerate, must be expressed with each other, so that the other person to learn to take care of you and cherish you, and vice versa, you need to give each other the same love. Relationship is a free choice, the advice and evaluation of others, is just a reference, the most important thing is the emotions and feelings of yourself and the other person. It is normal to feel confused and conflicted in a relationship because the more we love someone the more we want to have more. Therefore, one needs to learn to remain independent in a relationship; the only person who is likely to treat you with nothing but love is yourself. However, through the long term, one may realize that intimacy is not always about sticking together, but rather about being a sturdy support that one can feel comfortable clinging to when one partner is in a low or negative state, and the other can be a solid support for them. In giving hard and giving earnestly for someone you are sure you like and love dearly, this is okay, if one loses some rationality or does something to hurt other people who love them (such as parents and friends), such recklessness may be a blind and impulsive love rather than a healthy and mature love. It's not easy to meet someone you're attracted to and who also likes you, so I hope you can allow yourself to give it your all, but also rationally and thoughtfully keep your daily life rich and interesting. Good luck.

question: Why am I depressingly lonely and restless? Where am I headed in life?
description: I am a one-way thinker, always compulsively thinking of something in a good light, so much so that the first setback came and brought my whole life into a negative quagmire, and this state of affairs made me lose myself, fear of loss, fear of loneliness, fear of the cold shoulder, and the inability to make my own choices on where to go at every crossroads. Where did I go wrong.
keywords: Growth, Self-Growth, Self-Acceptance, Meaning of Life

answers.answer_text: It's a terrible feeling to see that you're used to positive expectations but can't accept setbacks and feel so lost and helpless that you can't make choices for yourself at every junction. When we go into things with high expectations, envisioning benign and perfect results, only to be defeated by imperfect results, we may feel that our previous efforts were meaningless, and that we have no idea what to do next. [Positive Expectation] It is good to have a positive expectation of everything and to work hard in order to reach your goals. It's just that, in order to make this approach more complete, we need to put a rider on this effort: do your best and accept the worst. Seeing that everyone grows up with realities that are out of their control and unacceptable. We need to see more of both sides of things to be complete with positive expectations. [Utilizing Resources] Seeing that you say you are lost, afraid of loss and loneliness, and afraid of the cold eye, I wonder if you have friends who are on the same wavelength as you are? There is a saying that relatives are the friends our parents bring us, but friends are the relatives we find for ourselves. Therefore, it is suggested that you find people around you who are in a comparable situation to you to be friends, and when you encounter problems, your friends may bring you more comfort and support. In your family, are there kind elders who can support to you? If there is, you can try to confide in him to feel the support and understanding he gives you. At least there is some tolerance that can make you feel more comfortable in your heart. May you get out of the haze soon. The world and I love you.

Hello questioner, "Why am I depressed and lonely and restless? Where am I headed in life?" These two questions, either one, are a big deal. It can be sensed that you've had some recent changes in your life that you're having a hard time accepting, it's got you fearful and intimidated, and so you're throwing out questions like these in the hopes that you can get some response. It's a question that no one on the other side of the fence can answer for you, and I don't know exactly what's going on in your life at the moment, so I can only give a little direction and advice. "Always thinking compulsively about the good side of things" - this way of thinking may be brought about by "insecurity". The human psyche works marvelously, and what is lacking will be automatically replaced. Lack of insecurity in the heart will make oneself constantly go to self-suggestion, telling oneself that those things which are feared will not happen, and those things which are dark and fearful will not happen. Such a way of thinking does have a positive meaning, it protects you from those negative thoughts inside, it is like a door that stops those bad emotions. But as you mentioned in your title, "so much so that the first setback brought my whole life into a negative quagmire", once reality and imagination split, once you can no longer continue to "self-hypnotize", this door can no longer stop the fear, dread and worry. The fears, the dreads, the worries, they swarm in and take over. They swarm over you and take over your mind. But I also want to invite you to look at them, they may be the scared version of yourself that you grew up with, that has always wanted you to be able to see it, but that you have closed the door to, and won't let out. A person's resilience to frustration, and the security that comes from their heart, are all tied to TA's upbringing. When you feel pain, is often also the best time to usher in the change, in the past there is a door can temporarily resist, but now, it seems to be the moment you have to face the real heart. The subject can try to find a trusted friend, psychological hotline to talk to talk, this stage will be very difficult to walk through alone, you can also try to find a suitable counselor to go through this difficult stage with you. Good luck! The world and I love you.

question: Being in the darkness and seeing the untouchable light, one would despair!
description: Just saw an article that said. A wizard. Taking care of a wife who couldn't get out of bed. He thought that his wife would be bored if she stayed there every day. So he went everywhere to see the scenery and then used magic to copy it down for his wife to see. But when the wife looked at it, she thought she could be more desperate. Why is this? I can't figure it out.

answers.answer_text: Plato had a cave myth, presumably that people didn't know they were shadows per se, and then were photographed to know they were shadows. It's the same story as yours. I don't think life has to be despair, if one is a shadow or a person who can lie, we also use shadows to perform plays, and language to create dramas.

question: Finding out that you didn't really love someone else may have just been attachment?
description: I had a crush on a guy in high school, and he was central air conditioned as if he was not there, causing me, who was young at the time, to make a painful decision not to love someone too much or I would get hurt. Since then, 2 boyfriends in college, 1 after work, and finally my ex-husband, I haven't felt very much love and I don't miss them terribly, especially not my ex-husband. But because of the type of childhood attachment I have, it causes me to have separation anxiety, so breakups hurt me a lot, if you ask me do you really love that much? Maybe the answer is no, more like insecurity and anxiety about the future. Could it be that I was never capable of love?

answers.answer_text: Beloved, I can tell you with certainty that from what I have witnessed, there are very few people who have the capacity to love. On the contrary, people who need to be loved are everywhere! So it is normal that you do not have the capacity to love. So there is no need to worry about it. On the contrary, a person who knows how to love himself will have happiness. You can try to learn to love yourself and create a harmonious and calm personal inner world for yourself! In this way, you will not be afraid!

question: Arguing with your husband and always wanting to get a divorce in the first place?
description: Husband rarely quarrel with me, but every time after the fight, I always leave home, always the first time want to divorce? Husband earns more money than me, I don't even care, don't want anything it doesn't matter, as long as the divorce is on the line!

answers.answer_text: Hello! I'm so happy for you to see you say that you and your husband rarely fight! Does this mean that the foundation of your relationship is still very good? Or does it mean that there is still a certain degree of mutual understanding and tolerance between you? Two people get along for a long time, it is inevitable that there will be some arguments, but your reaction is to walk away, or even think of divorce, why is this? Is it because you feel in your heart that two people should not have quarrels when they get along? Or is it that you don't tolerate your husband's arguments with you? I feel that your reaction is a bit like a child's, with the way of gambling, with the way of avoiding to face, with the either/or way to think about the husband and wife quarrel this thing. Leaving the house with an argument, just thinking that you don't want anything, just leave and forget about it. This may be a solution, but certainly not a good one. Of course, if your quarrel you reach the point where there is domestic violence and bodily harm, that's another matter. So how to understand and how to react if it's a normal couple's quarrel? Quarrels are also a form of communication. This form of communication often stems from the fact that both parties take their own sides of the issue, or communicate in an accusatory, blameful way. Realizing this, I think it is possible for change to begin. At the same time I want you to think about this pattern of coping in yourself. Was there a time when you felt some of these feelings growing up? You have applied this pattern before. Then the first step is to understand and repair some of your old traumatic feelings, to experience what you experienced in the past and what you are doing now in your married life. It is different to rethink what kind of new behavioral patterns you can have in your marriage and family. From there, you can go on to better cope with the fights to change the way of communication like arguing. You have to realize that if you keep adopting this way of leaving the house at the first quarrel, divorce hanging on your lips, there may come a day when your husband will be tired of coping with it and let you go, is this really what you want.

Husband and wife quarrel is a lot of marriage will have the phenomenon, leaving home is also good, both sides to avoid calm down, as for wanting to divorce is also very normal, the heart is not happy, don't want to aggravate themselves, although the husband earns more than me, but I can earn their own money, but also can be economically independent, what are not afraid of. This is why the divorce rate is so high nowadays, economically independent women prefer not to compromise themselves and are not afraid of divorce. But the idea can be flashed, calm down or need to think carefully, is it really to the point of divorce? If it is true that the three views do not match, quarrel frequently, no feelings, emotional impact, then leave it. If it is only trivial matters of life, the work of these issues can be resolved emotionally lead to quarrels, then give a chance to talk about it, each other and then rub a little, always find the most comfortable mode of living together.

Hello owner, many people like you (including me) there is no big conflict, it is the couple personality clash, feel inappropriate, fight every day, who can not let anyone. It is very difficult. Divorce, and can not give up, especially considering the children. If you don't divorce, what kind of life is this? Generally come to persuade are now make do, can not be divorced, but you guys like this in front of the child quarrel, really can not, this is still very harmful to the child, it would be better to separate the child good. However, marriage is a matter of two people, must be husband and wife heart are together, can be maintained, unrequited love is not. Even if one party does not want to divorce, but the other party is determined to divorce, such a marriage can not last long, whether it is the daily life of the conflict quarrels, or the other party to the court to sue for compulsory divorce, will always lead to the dissolution of the marriage, can not be maintained for a long time. And this is full of confrontation marriage, there is what warmth, drag and drag, is only consumed by both spouses are tired. Nowadays society is not like the past, bitterly guarding the marriage, waiting for the other party's return to the heart of the transfer, the prodigal son to return, this is too unfair to the guardian, bear too much pain, it is very cruel. And the biggest fear is that the couple is a contradiction in the loss of reason, resulting in serious consequences, but the original can be resolved by divorce, no must a road to black. Couples or the original good, can not divorce try not to divorce, destiny a not easy. However, some people together may not be suitable, involving cheating, domestic violence, gambling and drug abuse and other fault behavior, together is also very painful, early divorce early relief. In short, couples must work together, willing to walk through life, once a person wants to leave in the middle of the marriage is likely to face disintegration, which can not be salvaged by the efforts of one person. There are times when you are too tired to divorce, it's not about right or wrong. Good luck~.

question: Why do you get too possessive of your friends?
description: I'm especially possessive of my friends, she and my other relationship is not as good as her friends to play together, do not call on me I will be very difficult in my heart, and even self-mutilation, but also two days did not eat, hungry stomach ache, these are just want to let her care about me, pay attention to me
keywords: Interpersonal, communication, friends, roommates and classmates

answers.answer_text: Saw your question. I also have a small inconsistency in my heart. On the one hand I am a little heartbroken for you because you went so far as to starve yourself to the point of stomach ache by not eating for two days. On the other hand, it's also happy for you, because the title you gave to your question is being too possessive of your friends, which means that you can be clear about this matter. And want to know why, or what to do about it. Let's take a look at the situation together. What would it mean to you if she called on you to hang out with another friend? Being cared about, a sense of worth, or ......? Also, what does it mean to you that she's hanging out with another friend without calling up being? Ignored, not important yourself, or ......? It's not the possession itself that's controlling you here, it's how "possession" makes you feel and your understanding of what it means to possess a friend. The significance of possessing a friend to you is what makes you pursue the feeling of "possessing a friend" happily. Will starving yourself to the point of stomach ache really get you her attention? Probably. But what does this care and attention bring to your friend? Guilt, helplessness, or joy? If it doesn't bring joy to the friend, how will the care and attention last? Then the price you need to pay for the short-lived care and attention of your friend is to keep torturing yourself and hurting yourself. Or self-harm in exchange for the attention of a friend's guilt, helplessness and pain. Is this what you want? It's actually a vicious cycle. How do you break out of this vicious cycle? Here I would like to take the liberty of asking, how is your self-confidence? How is your sense of self-worth? When a person is full of self-confidence and a sense of self-worth, even if no one pays attention to her, she doesn't have such a strong desire to be paid attention to. Because she knows that whether that person, pays attention to her or not, she is still lovely and wonderful. Increasing one's sense of worth and presence may help break out of the vicious cycle. Anyway. What makes "owning a friend" so important? There are inner needs that need to be met, and each person's needs may be different. What is the "hole" that you are hungry for in this area? You can try to find out for yourself. Satisfy it in ways other than "possessing your friends".

Maybe you feel this way because you didn't get much love from your parents when you were a child. So friends are very important to you, maybe this friend gives you a kind of care, gives you warm feelings, you don't want this friend to "fall in love" with you. You don't want this friend to "fall out of love" with you, just as your mom and dad share their love with other siblings in the family. But your desire to be close to people, the desire to be cared for is too strong, if this will also cause a lot of trouble and pressure on the other side, so it is easy to lose friends, lose friendship. On the flip side think about how horrible it would be if you were hanging out with another friend B and your friend A was self-harming and not eating! I don't know why you choose to hurt yourself as a way to get to draw attention to the other person, if this worked in your upbringing so that's the only way you'll use it. If you feel that your friend's normal socialization like this hurts you, it's important that you learn to love yourself without hurting yourself again. Or maybe you just think inside that you are unworthy of being loved and you are self-punishing, but this self-punishment will only make you more and more sad. If you want the other person to care about you and pay attention to you, there are other ways you can do it that won't make you or the other person uncomfortable. For example, directly express your inner feelings, if you can't express them well, you can try to write them out and let your friends know.

Subject, hello, no matter how much you cherish, how much you like this friend, do not do self-mutilation, hunger strike and other behaviors that endanger life and health, to ensure the safety of life is the foundation, and then we can reap the benefits of friendship. Secondly, I really sympathize with you, and I can understand that you are sad that your friend did not ask you to go out together, and I can see that you really cherish this friend. It's unrealistic in most cases to expect to get an equal return for the affection you give. It's a very idealistic thought, and in real life, many times we don't get what we want. So when we give our feelings, we have to distinguish whether the other person can accept this kind of heavy feelings, has it caused any trouble to the other person? Otherwise, many times the efforts you make may be wishful thinking, and it is easy to hurt yourself. Timely communication is the only way to solve the problem. According to your description "he and my other relationship is not as good as his friends to play together, not call on me I will be very difficult in my heart", you judge from this one thing friends do not care about you, it seems to be a little unfair to her, because you did not tell her your heart, of course, she does not know that you are very sad, and also do not know that you are for the sake of this matter hunger strike She also didn't know that you were on a hunger strike or self-harming over this matter. This will only deepen your misunderstanding of her, only timely communication can solve the problem. According to your description, in order to make your friends care about you, pay attention to you, you even go so far as to self-harm, this behavior is a little radical, I do not know if you have been troubled by this radical emotions? If you yourself don't like to let this kind of bigotry occupy your brain, I suggest that you can seek the help of a psychiatrist and channel it in time, so that you don't let yourself be hurt in the meantime.

question: Too many worries, so tired of living, selfish to be happy?
description: In September 17, my husband suddenly felt unwell, went to the hospital to check the diagnosis of advanced cirrhosis of the liver, the beginning of conservative treatment, until June 19 to do a liver transplant, the family's expenses rely on my monthly salary of 3,000 yuan to maintain, and want to go out to earn a living, but can not let go of the child!

answers.answer_text: The world of adulthood is already a very difficult one, with the pressures of family, marriage and children weighing on one's shoulders, and it is only natural that one would have a lot of worries. I think the owner must be a very responsible person, really irresponsible people will just give up, not to raise such questions. Selfishness may be greedy for a moment's ease, but it may not always be so in his later life. All hearts are troubled by the heart, and the difficulties of the moment are only temporary. To share my story with you. When I was in high school, my mother had three major surgeries for breast cancer and ovarian cancer, and my dad stayed by my mom's side to take care of her during all three surgeries. At that time, my sister was going to college and I was preparing for the college entrance exams. The family was already burdened with a lot of money, plus my mother's illness required a lot of money, so our family was in darkness during that time. My parents are farmers, no work, my father is the only source of the family, my sister and I have to go to school, in order to take care of my mother father can only stay at home with the family, the family has no financial resources. My father sometimes lost his temper and felt overwhelmed, but never gave up on mom. My sister enrolled as a free teacher trainee in order to reduce her burden. I spent only two dollars a day in order to save some money for living expenses, and one dollar to buy a bun in the morning and a serving of rice at noon. I think those two years were the most bitter two years in my memory. But thankfully our family made it through. My mom has basically recovered, my sister has graduated from graduate school, and I am now in graduate school. We are basically financially independent after college, and my dad finds a part-time job at home when he has free time, and stays home with my mom when he doesn't want to. Our family is very happy now! Suffering may come to every family, but some people just get knocked down, and some people get more and more courageous. I think that's what happened to our family and will happen to yours. Although we don't know each other, I hope my story can give you some strength! Nowadays, the state will have support for the home for the very sick, so you can find out about the policy, and it may help your family!

question: Quick to perceive a call for help and unwilling to be mindfully dependent, why?
description: I'm always quick to sense when people are asking for help and then reach out, but don't want to be mindfully dependent. I feel like I attract around me, people who are dependent on me, even my leaders. The first person to find me to talk to about any troubles, hoping I'll fix it for him. In years past, I didn't see anything wrong with that, but this year I realized that he was so dependent that it made me feel misplaced and uncomfortable. Thinking back, my mom and I had the same relationship; I was always relied on as the one she confided in at an early age. Is it possible that I can rarely open my mouth and ask for help because I have some strange beliefs too?
keywords: Growth, Character Refinement, Personality Traits, Self-Growth

answers.answer_text: Dear Subject, Hello Wow~ Through your description, I can feel your confusion at the moment. Why is it that we seldom look for help, but instead often become dependent? First of all this is inextricably related to our early childhood development experience. If our needs are not well met and our expectations are not answered when we are babies from 0 to 6 months old, then subconsciously we will have the idea that I can't rely on anyone but myself, and this idea will penetrate into our daily life and personality. This is why many people, although they did not suffer any setbacks in their childhood and future growth experiences, have developed a more independent character, which is in fact inseparable from our experiences within six months. In addition, from the description of the subject, we can learn that when you were a child, you were already the object of your mother's confidences, and were often relied upon. And when we are small children, if we find that it is easier to perform a certain behavior to get the goodwill of our loved ones, then we are driven to keep repeating that behavior. For example, when you find it easier to be the object of your mother's confidences, and in the process she releases kindness towards you, then you will tend to get along that way. Similarly, when you have been relied upon by those around you and have received praise from others in the process, you will tend to become relied upon and will always be quick to perceive the need to ask for help in your dealings with others. Of course, if your ability is not good, even if others ask you for help can not get good help, then you will not become the object of dependence, so you are very capable, very charismatic kind of people, let people feel can be relied on. At the same time, people have inertia. People tend to be more inclined to look for help from those who have helped them, and when you give a helping hand to others, the next time they encounter difficulties, they will also prioritize the idea of looking for help from you. However, you're not always a superman, and when you're constantly relied on, especially by the very people who are supposed to be taking care of you, you tend to develop uncomfortable feelings over time. First of all, it's completely normal and reasonable for you to feel this way. You follow your feelings without feeling sorry or ashamed or any other emotion. The only way to be in good shape is to pay attention to your emotions and detoxify them yourself. Learn to politely decline. When you feel that others are asking for things that are beyond your burden and causing you a lot of stress, politely decline, or if sometimes you just don't feel like doing it yourself, then tell a little lie to decline. Find others to help with small things and enjoy the feeling of relying on others. To find others to help such things do not have to be a big thing, such as looking for others to help bring a breakfast, get a cup of water, hand a book, these are very small things. Find someone trustworthy to talk to when you are feeling annoyed. You are also allowed to rely on others. In the end, each of us in this world, only when they follow their own will to live, so living is comfortable and cozy. I hope the subject can get rid of the trouble soon~.

Seeing words like seeing faces, I hope these words can bring you a little warmth. You must be a very, very capable person to be trusted and relied upon by so many people. However, the character "person" is a structure of mutual support. Just relying on and being relied upon blindly will not make you feel happy. I hope you can also learn to selectively refuse the dependence of others, learn to depend on others, and relax a bit. In this regard, I have a few small suggestions. Uphold your legitimate rights and interests. There is an ancient Chinese saying that goes, "The capable should do more," but there is also "The one who does more gets more." When your leader wants you to solve a problem, you might as well consider whether your salary matches the effort you put in. If the salary is far from enough, you can jokingly say, "If you keep doing this, you'll have to give me a raise," or you can take a long vacation to make your leader realize your importance and necessity and keep you by offering a higher salary. Honestly express your exhaustion. When a person is too capable, it will make people consciously or unconsciously overlook the fact that this person also gets tired, and they will rely on him comfortably. What you need to do is to speak out your exhaustion, tell others, "I am not invincible, I do get tired." After they know this, they will reduce the frequency of seeking your help. Or they won't disturb you when you are tired. Learn to refuse. If you are very tired and have expressed it, but someone still asks for your help; or it is some trivial matter, you can refuse to help. It's not being heartless, it's not being cold-blooded, on the contrary, this is your rationality: you can't do a good job when you are too tired; and with your ability, you don't need to do insignificant things. Don't feel embarrassed, you don't owe others anything. A person should first love oneself, and then love others. Learn to depend. Although you are very capable, one person cannot do everything. Sometimes, learn to depend on others, which not only improves efficiency but also relaxes your mood. Depending on others is the same as refusing others, there is no need to feel embarrassed. We have a relationship of mutual help and interdependence, and only with reciprocity can we build deeper relationships. I hope you can find a balance, helping others while not feeling too tired. Otherwise, if you always help others, they will only have two reactions: 1. Feel indebted to you and instinctively stay away from you; 2. Get used to your help, and when one day you no longer help them, they will think you have "become bad" and develop resentment towards you.

answers.answer_text: Hugs to the owner. You are only 12 years old and you are carrying this huge anxiety and pressure inside you and there is no one around you to understand and support you, it feels very painful, doesn't it? You want someone who understands you, cares about you, and can give you support and comfort when you face all kinds of problems and pressures. When your needs are not met and you cannot find any other solution, you only think of "death" as a solution. In fact, "death" is not an effective solution, and you don't need to go that far. At your age, you are beginning to know more about the world, and you are receiving more and more complicated information from the outside world, and your self-consciousness is also being formed and strengthened step by step. The various conflicts between the outside world and the inner world have formed a great impact on you, and you don't know how to face and solve them for a while, so you are also very confused and anxious inside, right? You also mentioned that you may have felt so painful inside recently because of too much pressure from studying and parents' lack of understanding. Are you in the fifth or sixth grade now? As you are facing the critical period from elementary school to secondary school, studying is indeed a very important thing and there is also a lot of pressure. Your parents must have given you a lot of expectations and pressure, but probably due to busy work or some other reasons, they didn't take care of your feelings and emotions, and just thought that you were overthinking things, and that you should focus on your studies. Your best friends and girlfriends have different concerns and feelings, and they don't understand you and offer comfort either. It can be seen that you are a person with a sensitive heart, with your own opinions and ideas, and a high degree of self-awareness, and you will think more than your peers in your thoughts, so they can't understand you for a while, but it doesn't mean that they don't love you, don't value you, or don't care about you, it only means that you are different from them in terms of your thoughts and concerns. You might as well sort yourself out, figure out what the pressure you're facing mainly comes from, and then address it in a targeted way. If it's academic stress, you can look at what the specific problem is - is the course too hard to understand? Too much homework to do? Worrying about not doing well on a test? ...... Regardless, there is always a solution to problems related to studying, because these problems are just as likely to be experienced by your classmates and friends. Your teachers naturally want their students to take their studies seriously and get good grades, so they will also help you to face and solve these problems. You can talk to your teachers and seek their help to guide you through specific problems and rediscover the confidence and joy of learning. You can also talk to your parents and let them know how you are studying and how you feel, what difficulties you are facing, and how they need to help and support you. Then they will not simply say "you think too much" and dismiss you. At the same time, also know how to combine labor and leisure, in the tension of the study, they should also be appropriate to relax. Cultivate some extracurricular hobbies or sports, find friends with common interests to go together, to find and feel the beauty and hope in life. I can see that you attach great importance to learning, and hope to study well and be a good student who is good at learning and upward mobility. Study problems make you feel great pressure, that's why you have these troubles now. When you have these worries and stresses, it means that you value them and want to solve them. When you want to solve them, it is the beginning of a change, which means that there is still hope for everything. So don't give up so easily. Forget about suicide, you still have a long way to go in life, there are still a lot of good things waiting for you to experience, your parents, friends, teachers still love you, care about you, and will always be with you. You can also come up here more often to pour out your heart and seek help, we are all here. The world and I love you. Than heart~.

answers.answer_text: You tend to be pleasing and obedient in your interactions with people, suppressing your needs, afraid to start conflicts, and feeling tired. These behaviors and feelings of yours tend to be a kind of ingratiating personality psychology. ****** When you were 4 or 5 years old, if you cried, your mother ignored you and comforted you, or even scolded you, causing you to suppress your emotions and not dare to express them. This long-term experience will make you develop a pleasing mentality. Because we are not capable of being independent when we are young, we must rely on adults to take care of us and fulfill our survival and security needs. When we develop negative emotions, adults do not accept them or give positive feedback, but respond with negative means of scolding and suppressing. Our young minds feel threatened by our survival and develop a sense of fear and insecurity, so we respond by suppressing our emotions and needs, and by pleasing and obeying adults in order to avoid conflict and harm, to gain acceptance and approval, and to survive. In the long run, the pleasing personality is formed, and even as an adult, this pattern of thinking and behavior is still used to cope with the outside world and interpersonal interactions. As you can see, people with a pleasing personality experience fear in interpersonal interactions, find it difficult to reject others, want to be recognized by others, and do not understand their own boundaries and bottom lines, which means it is difficult for them to be themselves easily and freely. Over time, it is natural to feel physically and mentally exhausted, and to feel pressure and resistance to social activities. ****** So how to break it?1. Acceptance of self First of all, you have to accept this character trait of your own, accept your own true experience and emotions, do not need to resist it, dislike or shame, do not deny its existence. To accept it as a characteristic of you, a feature of you. Although such a personality and behavior can have some negative effects on relationships, in a positive sense, this character trait of yours is actually a protection for you. Due to the influence of the growing environment, your such a characteristic can protect you to grow up smoothly, avoid harm, integrate into society, it is your response to the outside world and the formation of a "functional self", so it is of significance. 2, learn to emotionally express the need to learn to accept their own emotional expression. Whether it's positive or negative emotions, they have a meaning and need to be expressed, not suppressed. You can try to learn to express your emotions and thoughts to trustworthy or close people, often practice, get positive and affirmative feedback, and then expand to more people. It's also a good idea to write down your emotions and thoughts, and free-write whatever comes to mind. Not only can you ease your negative emotions, but also allows you to actually understand what your inner thoughts and needs are, and affirmation of the self. 3, looking for safe experience can go to notice and look for safe experience in their own lives. Feel, in what kind of environment space, with what people, how to do, so that you feel safe, sure and free. And then more self-adjustment and change in this experience, slowly eliminate their fear of socialization and insecurity. 4, set the bottom line to explore and set their own boundaries and bottom line. In the interaction with people, there should be a certain sense of boundaries, to be clear about where their own bottom line, to what extent they can withstand, if you touch the bottom line will have how to feel and react, their own expectations in this regard. This will help you strengthen your sense of control and avoid being hurt by crossing boundaries and touching unknown bottom lines, and creating anxiety and fear when you lose control. These are some of my suggestions and I hope they are useful to you. The ingratiating personality mental model has formed a fixed pattern of thinking and behavior after a long period of influence and accumulation, and it is difficult to make changes at once. You need to give yourself some time and opportunity to experience and try, and slowly adjust and change.

question: What can I do about the huge difference in thinking with my husband and the huge loneliness in my married life?
description: I have a big difference in thinking with my husband, and I often argue with him about important and trivial matters. I can cooperate with my husband in daily life, but it is difficult for them to communicate with each other. What can I do if I feel lonely in my marriage?

answers.answer_text: Hello subject, what to do when there is a huge sense of loneliness in married life? First of all, we need to understand what loneliness is, is it two people together will not be lonely? According to the psychological definition, loneliness is a subjective and conscious feeling and experience of isolation and alienation from others or society, rather than an objective state. Therefore, there are also people who are surrounded by a group of people and still feel lonely. Loneliness is not on the physical level but on the psychological level. Secondly, why do you feel lonely in marriage? [There is a big difference in thinking between my husband and I. They argue about big and small things from time to time.] This may be the reason, not communicating with each other as frequently and feeling like living in two worlds. We have all kinds of needs in life, and loneliness arises when a certain need is not met, or when expectations are not met. Finally, how to alleviate loneliness? Note the use of alleviate here, no one person can completely remove loneliness, and you can't find two people in the world who are exactly the same. You expect to connect with your husband, but at this stage it is not possible to reach the same frequency. If that's the case, why not try going through the experience of creating something in common together? Pick something that both of you would like to do, such as photography, hiking, traveling and so on. I believe that the more you have something in common, the better your relationship will be and the less time you will have to experience loneliness.

Unfortunate marriages are each unfortunate in their own way. Probably there are quite a few people like you who feel lonely in their marriages. Everyone wants to find his or her right partner, so a good partner is first a good friend and then a husband or wife. We want to have a close friend in our daily life so that life is not so sad. Even if life is difficult, there is someone to hold hands with. Unfortunately, many people rush into marriage without really knowing each other. Already in the marriage, and for various reasons, can not just leave, so there is a marriage in the lonely. Fortunately, people are social animals, although the marriage can not get comfort, we still have friends, try to find your three or five confidants, from time to time gatherings, can drain the loneliness of your life, can help you solve the puzzle, give you spiritual support. In addition, you can cultivate new hobbies, hobbies in the life, I believe that your days will be more fulfilling and complete. Life is always a variety of bad, many people and you, you are not alone.

The initial purpose of marriage is not just to find someone to live with, but to develop an intimate relationship with that person. You want to be able to communicate with your husband not only by taking care of your daily life, but also by communicating with him. You feel a great sense of loneliness because of the big difference in thinking with your husband, and the constant arguments you have with him. The big difference in thoughts may not be the problem, how to see this difference is the problem. If you see only one possibility in everything, and think that you are right and good, and not the same as you are wrong and bad, then there are differences, there are disagreements, and if you are not the same, you will have to argue about what is right and what is wrong. Always want to have their own say, can win the right and wrong, but will lose the relationship. If you can have curiosity about the differences between each other, heart to understand each other, to see why he would think that way, those differences may be some good resources, two people understand each other can take advantage of the strengths and weaknesses, to open up a bigger picture.

Hello subject! You've described some of your confusion in a few short sentences, which I probably interpreted to mean that it seems like you're a bit helpless in dealing with the conflict between the two parties. Since there is no specific incident, I can only make some guesses. You said that you and your husband have a big difference in thinking and that you have to argue about everything. Then you recall, when you first fell in love and decided to get married, was it the same? What were the things that attracted you to each other? Why is this a problem now, and what exactly happened? It is impossible to have an intimate relationship without conflict. Relationships last longer when we are equipped with how to handle conflict. You say that you and your husband can work together in everyday cooking, so you can actually work together to deal with problems, so think about why you're on the same page in those areas. Find the commonalities and then see the differences. question: Tired of enduring the pain of his childish behavior after marriageWhat to do?
description: Love for a year married twelve years to serve the sick father-in-law six years old child eleven years old is my parents to help us take care of the support of my career husband's family non-stop something father-in-law is sick father-in-law's mother can not withstand the pain of the loss of a son drank pesticides to commit suicide in-laws just found a younger than their own seven years old companion of the husband's examination for the qualification examination for six or seven years so far did not get out of the exams I'm very tired!

answers.answer_text:
Hello, you have been married for 12 years and have shouldered a lot of burdens for your family, especially your husband's family. It seems that various things have happened to your husband's parents and even his grandmother, which is indeed quite difficult. Although you did not describe it in the question, from the title, it can be seen that these things have brought you a lot of pressure. However, it seems that your husband has not been able to help you much, and I think that's where you feel wronged, right? 

The boundary between the nuclear family and the extended family is different in Chinese families compared to Western families. After marriage, the nuclear family becomes an independent unit, usually consisting of one's own parents and the husband's parents. Of course, in China, it is not possible to completely achieve this. Our culture and customs dictate that parents help us take care of our children, which creates various relationships with our own families on one hand. Such a family system can provide us with a lot of support, both in terms of behavior and psychology. But on the other hand, it also brings a lot of burdens, especially in your husband's family, where they seem unable to take care of themselves well. You need to shoulder a lot of responsibilities. However, this does not mean that you cannot maintain certain boundaries. These boundaries are practical on one hand and psychological on the other. 

When your father-in-law gets sick, you have to take care of him, and if your mother-in-law attempts suicide, things are bound to be chaotic. But what effect does it have on you when your mother-in-law finds a partner who is seven years younger than her? Is it possible that you are too deeply involved in their lives? Your title says that you cannot accept your husband's immaturity, but from the description, many of your troubles seem to be related to his family's problems. As children, we should take care of and help our families, but we also need to believe that they have the ability and right to solve their own problems. When you mentally withdraw a little bit, you still need to do certain things, but your mentality will be different. In other words, you can be physically tired but not mentally tired. 

The most important thing is your relationship with your husband and your own nuclear family. You mentioned that your husband displays many immature behaviors. What does that mean? Is he not growing up or not independent enough? Without knowing the situation of your relationship with him, if you are used to being controlling and wanting to manage everything, then he is even less likely to grow up. So, take more time to look at your status, your relationship, and how to manage your nuclear family. Also, pay more attention to yourself, your emotions, and your current state. What has happened recently? You have been married for 12 years and have experienced many things. Regardless of the situation, you have managed to overcome them. I don't know if there have been any recent events that have made you feel exhausted, but starting to reflect on your own patterns is a good thing and can be the beginning of change.~ Good luck, and may you grow on the path of life!

I can understand the discomfort of just starting school, after all, I just started school too (cover your face), and the change in lifestyle and environment can be a bit of a shock both physically and psychologically. As for whether or not you need to see a doctor, it's a relatively subjective thing, especially since it doesn't seem to be particularly serious. Therefore, let me start by giving you an overview of the process and content of a visit to the psychiatry/psychology department of a hospital. Generally speaking: our first visit is to a psychiatrist, who will ask you about your complaint (why you're coming to the doctor, what symptoms you have, etc.), then ask you to do some scales (such as the Symptom Self-Criticism Scale, Depression and Anxiety Self-Rating Scale, and even the Minnesota Personality Inventory), and then combine the results of your own descriptions and assessments with your diagnosis (i.e., what's wrong with you), and then finally recommend medication or medication for your condition, or do something about your condition. You'll be advised to take medication or get counseling depending on your situation. Therefore, I think if you have insomnia and are easily affected by things around you, going to see a doctor is a safe choice. Through the scores of the scale and the doctor's diagnosis, you can have a clearer understanding and judgment of the severity of your problem, and you will not be at a loss. Of course, psychiatrists are more interested in providing diagnosis and medication. Based on your description above, I can see that you are sensitive to your surroundings and you like to attribute the causes to yourself, which is a mode of thinking that may bring you a great mental burden. Therefore, I suggest that it is more necessary for you to seek psychotherapy in addition to seeking help from a psychiatrist. You can also seek help from your school's counseling center if psychotherapy in hospitals is more expensive. Good luck!
