question: I have a hard time getting pleasure from socializing and was wondering if socializing is necessary?
description: I have a hard time getting pleasure from socializing, there is no way to feel safe, so I am mostly subconsciously defensive in my dealings with people, and even though I tell myself that other people are not a threat to me, there is never a way to trust them, resulting in an inability to build close relationships and very few friends around me. I don't want this habit to continue, after all, this is a group life.

answers.answer_text: Hello! Socializing has some validity for the individual, but not necessity. Especially nowadays, information, logistics, transportation, etc. are so convenient and fast that you can get most of the services you want by paying for them, and you don't always need friends and family to help you out. The effectiveness of socializing does not lie in the short-lived pleasure gained, but in whether one can draw from it the nutrients that can be used for one's better existence, such as being more energetic, more insightful, more courageous, and more ambitious. To determine whether the socialization is effective, you can refer to the following example: 1, you are a firewood, he is a cowherd, you two met on the hillside after chatting for half a day, his cattle are full, your firewood? This is the ineffective socialization. 2, you are firewood, he is cattle herding, you two met on the hillside after chatting for half a day, his cattle ate enough, through chatting with him, you know the east side of the mountain more firewood trees, the west side of the mountain there is a cliff of death, the next day you go to the east side of the mountain to cut a lot of firewood home. 3, you are the firewood, he is the cattle herding, you two met on the hillside and chatted for half a day, his cattle ate enough, where is your firewood? This is effective socialization. 3, you are firewood, he is a cattle rancher, you two met on the hillside after chatting for half a day, his cattle are full, and finally a conspiracy, you decided to open a grilled beef skewer store in partnership at the entrance of the village, you cut the firewood grilled beef skewers have a special flavor, three years later you have opened a total of 50 stores, five years later, your kebab company went public. This is effective use of socialization. A study says that many intelligent people are unable to experience true happiness in social situations, and that participating in social activities instead causes them anxiety for no apparent reason, so they display a withdrawn and out-of-touch temperament. ● Writer Eileen Chang once said: what social activities she participated in, and when she came back to think about it, every word she said and every action she did, she felt so stupid that she actually regretted and almost hated it. Zhang Xiaolong, the founder of WeChat, also said: I've never seen a hilarious person who shines brightly. It's true that it's hard to build intimacy without being able to trust people all the time, and it affects the richness of an individual's life to a certain extent, but poor socialization destroys the quality of life just as much. Time is a scarce resource when you don't have strong relationships with people, and learning to be alone can be a premium over spending time on poor quality and ineffective socializing.

Hello owner, I am happy to answer your queries. First of all, let's briefly sort out the confusion in your question. From your question, I have sorted out the following two confusions: I wonder if socializing is a necessary activity. If socializing is necessary, I want to find some ways to make myself happy from socializing. [Confusion Analysis] {First Confusion} I think everyone has a different understanding of whether socializing is necessary. Some will say, "Some accomplished monks, or practitioners who live in seclusion in deep forests, they just live alone and have some accomplishments of their own." Some say, "Socializing is a necessary activity for everyone, even if you are playing games alone at home, but it is also full of social activities in the virtual world." From a psychological point of view, those who are able to live truly alone and have a good attainment of spiritual thought, they are not really alone, shall we say, but they have had a rich and full relationship at one time. This fullness of relationship has been internalized within them so that they are always nourished by it. So, even though these practitioners appear to be alone, they are actually practicing with a relationship within them. Then, if we put it in a sociological perspective, the importance of relationship is even more self-evident. The whole human civilization is accomplished by the joint collaboration of human beings, and the collaboration between human beings definitely needs the establishment and support of relationship. Therefore, from a broader perspective, relationships are also very important. Of course, for individuals, relationships also mean the building of our intimate relationships, the formation of marriage and family, the maintenance of social network relationships, etc. Each of us is woven into the great web of relationships. Without relationships, all that we have now may cease to exist. {Second Confusion} Having just talked about the importance of relationships, I think you are more concerned with the question of how to enable yourself to build secure, stable and intimate relationships. In your question, you said that "you are always subconsciously defensive, and there is always no way to trust others." From a psychological point of view, these are typical psychological states of insecurity. However, the establishment of a sense of security does not mean that you live in a safe space, but rather a subconscious feeling. The same piece of the world is felt differently by each of us. Just like standing in front of an ocean, some people feel the beauty of the ocean, they can feel the sea breeze, the sea water lapping; however, some people feel boundless fear, they are worried that the storm will come at a certain time, so they are always anxious, and even less in the mood to enjoy the beauty of the world. This is the effect of insecurity on everyone's heart; it changes the way we perceive the world and prevents us from perceiving the good things. So what are the direct causes of insecurity? If we trace the root of the problem, we tend to think that it is some problems between the baby and the child in infancy and early childhood, I here from the more realistic two perspectives to look at the problem of lack of security: 1. Attention tendency like the sea story mentioned above, insecure people tend to allocate their attention to the disaster, pain, and some negative things. Just like a flower inserted in the stool, some people see the flower first, some people pay attention to the stool first. 2. will temporal push to the future or to the above example of the sea, security will be full of people will pay more attention to the present thing, and insecurity will be by the present a thing push to the future, and amplification and catastrophe, for example, to see a relatively large waves lapping over, may be associated with will not be immediately There is a storm coming. The above two ways of thinking are commonly used by people with a lack of security, so what can we do to improve our inner security? The establishment of a sense of security is not an easy thing to do, just like our heart owes a debt, we have to pay it back slowly. Gradually build up from the closest people. Despite being the closest person, you may be defensive, but that's okay, because a long time together will slowly loosen your closed inner door. Seek help from a professional psychologist. If you still find it difficult to build a sense of security, you may want to find a psychological teacher, because a learned psychological teacher is more likely than others to give you a trusting and tolerant environment, avoiding inadvertent harm in the relationship and making you retreat into a world of one's own. I hope the above reply is helpful to you.

After you have answered these questions, you may want to try to find your own circle of people with similar interests with whom you will feel more joy and inner stability. Finally, I would like to say that the establishment of intimate relationships requires more than just socializing, first of all, we need to find and like a person from the bottom of our hearts, and secondly, we need to have the ability to love, which sometimes needs to be cultivated. Just because you can't have an intimate relationship doesn't mean you can't love, it means that the time is not ripe yet, and when you are able to be happy and secure without socializing, then I think you will have the ability to love people as well as yourself. Lastly, I wish us all the best, and I hope the above will help the subject, thank you for reading.

According to Maslow's hierarchy of needs theory, human needs consist of five levels: physiological needs, safety needs, belonging and love needs, respect needs, and self-actualization needs. Among them, socialization needs belong to belonging and love needs - a person requires emotional connection or relationship with other people. According to this theory, people can survive just as well without socialization, but it will affect the fulfillment of our higher level needs and will affect the overall happiness of our lives. Everyone has different personalities and different attitudes towards social activities. It is good to have the ability to socialize as long as we have it, and we don't have to force ourselves too much towards socializing, we can adjust our attitudes towards socializing appropriately. We can follow our heart and reduce the frequency of socializing, and we should also improve our social skills appropriately. Good luck ~.

Thanks for seeing a lot of pretty good replies. So I'm going to reply to you from a different angle. I wonder if you've ever thought about what your role is in society? What is your role in the family? What is your role in life? Whether or not socializing is necessary depends on your own role description. I think your self-description is more important: your state: insecure and defensive ...... your hope: you don't want to continue like this ...... So see what you can do about this so that you can adjust this habit? I would rather suggest that you deal with this insecurity within. I used to be very insecure person, and through five years of studying psychology and meditation, I gradually adjusted myself and thus also changed my perception of the world, of society. So if you improve yourself, you will naturally figure out a lot of things. Another thing about insecurity, it turns out that it is affected from the time we are in our mother's womb. If our mother is not in good shape when she is pregnant, and if she fails to respond to us in a timely manner when she is breastfeeding, it can all lead to insecurity or anxiety.

People are social animals. Karl Marx said: "The essence of man is the sum of all social relations." The position in the social network determines a person's social status and even their value. Therefore, socializing is a practical need. A person needs to expand their network, optimize their relationships, so they participate in various clubs, engage in social activities, promote themselves, and seek recognition from others. This is the opportunity to obtain more social resources and improve one's quality of life. It is undeniable that this is also one of the driving forces for social progress, especially for Chinese people who value relationships. However, in modern commercial society, the key still lies in one's abilities. By doing one's own job well, one can secure their own position. Is it really necessary to engage in ineffective socializing? I think not. It would be better to use that time for learning and self-improvement. Ultimately, one relies on oneself, and it is only what one truly possesses that can give them confidence.

question: Girl is 17 and while playing with her best friend she kissed her and felt disgusting?
description: We are very close and just when we were playing she kissed me on the mouth a little bit, it made me feel sick and now when I think back on it, there is a little bit of revulsion, what's wrong with me?

answers.answer_text: Hello subject. While you were hanging out with your girlfriends, the other person kissed you on the mouth a little bit, which made you feel disgusted, and now when you think about it you feel disgusted and find it hard to accept. Most people can't accept that there is kissing behavior with the same sex, and I think this is a relatively normal situation. The Cognitive Behavioral Therapy view of psychology states that emotions arise not because of the event itself, but the way a person perceives the event. So we also find that different people have different attitudes and feelings towards the same event. In the case of being kissed on the mouth by a friend of the same sex, most people's view of the event might be, "Same-sex and this kind of behavior is wrong and shameful." A deeper thought might be, "The other person is dirty." So feelings of disgust can arise. Imagine if it is a person of the opposite sex, whom one desires, who has the behavior of kissing oneself, then one will certainly not develop the feeling of disgust and resistance. This is because one would interpret such behavior of the other person as meaning that the other person adores him or her and that he or she is loved. This kind of behavior between people of the same sex will be interpreted as: one is not respected and one is violated by the other person. In the other person's view, perhaps the other person is also expressing his or her own meaning of liking and wanting to be close to him or her, only that the behavior used by the other person is kissing, a kind of behavior that is not accepted by the general public as an expression of liking between people of the same sex. When you feel uncomfortable and unacceptable, it is possible to express your feelings to the other person. You can talk to the other person about your inability to accept such intimate physical contact between people of the same sex. You can also listen to the intention behind the behavior. You can talk to your girlfriends about how you can better express your feelings for each other in the course of your relationship. For example, you can express your feelings verbally, by giving small gifts, etc. Everyone has their own way of expressing their feelings. Everyone has their own way of expressing their feelings, and maybe there's no right or wrong way to do it. But everyone has their own boundaries, not just mental boundaries, but physical boundaries as well. When we feel our boundaries are violated by others, we need to defend them in an appropriate way. Relationships are a back-and-forth process, and we need to communicate openly with each other so that we can slowly learn about each other's preferences and boundaries. You can also use a small tool in the rational emotional therapy to improve such emotions, this small tool is called "RET self-help table", also known as "three-column table". This tool is called the "RET Self-Help Sheet", also known as the "Three-Column Sheet", which is a list of events that happened, the emotional feelings they brought you, and all of your opinions and beliefs about them. After you've done this, you can review each of your beliefs to see if they are all reasonable. For example, one of the beliefs we might have about this incident is, "She kissed me, she's a lesbian." We can question that belief a little bit, does that really make her a lesbian? Eventually we will realize that many of our beliefs are untenable. When beliefs are loosened, one's resulting emotions improve. These are my answers and I hope they help you. Blessings to you.

Hi Subject ~ Your best friend gave you a kiss and you felt disgusted, check out the following two reasons why personal boundaries are broken. We slowly find and establish our boundaries as we grow up. Physical boundaries refer to your acceptance of social distance from others. Even with closer people, we maintain a distance that makes us feel comfortable. This distance may shorten when we are sad and need comfort, such as a desire for a hug. It may also change with age. What was your pattern of getting along like a few years ago? Is it possible that a recent increase in personal awareness has made you not want to be overly intimate with others? But your BFF broke that boundary when you didn't expect or need to, so it made you feel disrespected and created disgust. Seventeen is the time when self-identity is being formed and your own gender identity is becoming more apparent. Adolescent girls are emotionally sensitive and, in the context of society, may think that kissing is a gesture between lovers to express their love. Too intimate physical behavior between women will make them not want to be misunderstood by others, afraid that their girlfriends are not "unintentional kisses", but also refuse to go in this direction. This can also lead to psychological aversion. Be clear about your social distance and express your feelings when you feel uncomfortable. It's also a good idea to observe what your best friend's personal boundaries look like. Does she exhibit this same behavior when she's around others? The closer people are, the easier it is to cross the boundaries between them. Mutual respect can minimize misunderstandings and maintain a longer lasting friendship ~ good luck~.

"We are friends who are as close as one, and at the same time we are two separate people." Imagine that everyone has their own house, set in a garden with a beautiful fence around the edge. This is "my space" and the fence is "my boundary". Within the boundary, you feel safe and comfortable, free to socialize with others while protecting yourself. Boundaries are also formed slowly during the process of growth, and self-esteem, self-confidence, self-worth, self-awareness, etc. are all related, which is an inevitable process of [independence] and [separation] in the process of growth. When someone intrudes into your garden, you will naturally feel uncomfortable, perhaps the feeling of being invaded and spied upon, or the feeling of being out of control. It is always uncomfortable. Be brave and say [no] yah, show your attitude, show your boundaries. Say no.

answers.answer_text: Owner, thanks for the invitation. One thing that's kind of interesting that I've noticed more than once in my life is that even the most confident people have an inferiority complex part in them. There are those who will set a very high goal to give themselves false hope to hide their low self-esteem, and there are those who will avoid low self-esteem by putting all sorts of obstacles in the way of their success and pretending that they are intentionally not trying. If you're experiencing déjà vu, it may indicate that you're experiencing some of the difficulties that ordinary people experience. The point I want to make today is not how to help you get rid of your low self-esteem, but what we do with our low self-esteem. The first step, of course, is to realize that its existence is a normal thing, and to be able to face up to and accept that existence. Secondly, I would like to recommend the book "Micro Habits" by Stephen Gass to you. In it, he suggests that we reverse the overly high and unattainable goals we set and simplify them into very small micro-habits that we won't fail in doing. For example, if you read a book, change your plan of "reading an hour a day" to "reading a page at a time" or even "reading a paragraph at a time", or change your plan of "working out for an hour a day" to "working out for an hour a day". work out for an hour a day" to "work out for five minutes a day" or even "work out for one minute a day", this is the practice of micro-habit. A paragraph read down, continue to a page, two pages to do, may not realize that a book is finished; a minute to do, continue to five minutes, ten minutes to move forward, may not realize that the completion of an hour. Once you take the first step, you will become more and more confident to take more steps. As you continue to accomplish your plans and even go beyond what you set out to do, you will become more and more confident. Think about what you want to achieve right now, how you can break it down into a micro-habit that's very easy to achieve, and then do it a little bit at a time for a week to see if you make a difference. answers.answer_text: The owner said he had hallucinations, I do not know what kind of sound the owner usually hallucinate? Hallucinations can be categorized into verbal hallucinations and primitive hallucinations, verbal hallucinations are hearing audible words out of thin air; while primitive hallucinations are hearing non-verbal sounds or inaudible verbal sounds out of thin air. Most commonly seen in schizophrenia, also seen in bipolar disorder, rare in wistful psychosis, depersonalization and cerebral organic mental disorder. * Mainly include: (1) non-verbal sounds: primitive phantom hearing of non-verbal sounds include: * through the mouth of other people or animals issued by the non-verbal sounds: for example, crying and laughing, coughing, animal barking; * nature sounds: for example, the sound of the water flow, the sound of the rain; * mechanical sounds: for example, the sound of the train, the sound of the knocking, the sound of the slapping; * electronic sounds: for example, the sound of the radio tuning sound, the ringing of the cell phone; * tinnitus: some authors will be Tinnitus is categorized as phantom hearing and should be classified as primitive phantom hearing. Tinnitus (hissing, ringing, buzzing) is the result of hyperactivation of brainstem nuclei or primary auditory cortex. (2) Inaudible speech sounds: the patient's phantom hearing develops from inaudible speech sounds to verbal phantom hearing, which is the aggravation of phantom hearing, and the verbal phantom hearing gradually becomes smaller and smaller to inaudible after treatment, which is the alleviation of phantom hearing. If the phantom speech sounds fluctuate between inaudible and audible, this is less severe than pure verbal phantom hearing. According to the above situation, the owner can see what kind of phantom hearing, phantom hearing is often found in schizophrenia, it is recommended that the owner go to the psychiatric department of the hospital for diagnosis as soon as possible. Good luck!

You see your own shortcomings reflected in others, which leads to your dislike of others, and essentially, you dislike yourself for having these shortcomings. Yet, you often refuse to change." For the six issues you mentioned, some of them can be easily resolved. For example, smoking and speaking. If you reflect on yourself and find that you do not engage in these behaviors, then it is entirely up to others. In this case, you can kindly suggest to them to refrain from smoking or speaking loudly at certain times. While this may not solve all the problems at once, most people will listen to advice, and this can help avoid some troubles and reduce your own disdain. As for joking, appearance, talking about family matters, and work, the four things you despise, appearance is something innate and bestowed by your parents. In daily life, try to avoid joking with "strangers," but with close friends, joking is more acceptable. After all, your friends understand your intentions and won't take offense. However, in your question, I did not see any mention of your "communication," but rather that you only focus on yourself. As for family matters, it is enough to just listen and make changes where necessary. In doing so, those who merely talk without action will often run out of topics. After reading this text, I feel a little headache, as if I see a small boat in the middle of the sea, with no way to come and no way to return. This is a very informative passage, so I'll try to rationalize it and you can see if there are any problems with what I'm saying. First, you're sick and on medication. Second, you're married and haven't felt like your husband lately. Third, you want to go to school and don't want to go to work, or rather, don't want to take classes that have room for advancement. Fourth, Grandma is concerned about you. Fifth, your family is always accusing you of not knowing what to do. Sixth, you don't want to get well, you want to stay sick. Seventh, you feel aggrieved and resentful at the same time, and want to know what's right and is good for you. Eighth, you want to get better and be recognized and loved by those around you. I don't know if I've misunderstood anything? There is a word in psychology called defense mechanisms. A defense mechanism is, a mental operation that eliminates unpleasant emotional components from the conscious level. Unpleasant emotions include anxiety, depression and anger. Anxiety is made up of unpleasant feelings coupled with speculation about frightening events. Depressed emotions, on the other hand, are composed of unpleasant feelings plus perceptions of the occurrence of terrible events. Anger is made up of unpleasant feelings plus thoughts of destroying someone or something. For none of the above emotional responses, the content of these thoughts may be derived from perceptions and memories held so far in any developmental stage of childhood, and may be reality-based, imagination-based, or both. ---- The Masks of the Mind - 101 Psychological Defenses My understanding is that some past events feel so horrible that we consciously and unconsciously prevent the feeling from coming. The reason why we would know that the feeling is too horrible is because we used to live with it and can't resolve it or escape it. Your problem gives me the feeling that your family is giving you a lot of pain and you want to escape, but you can't live with it yourself, so you are very conflicted. The ones around you can't understand you, and although there are many people around you, you still feel very lonely. Because no one's heart and your heart are together, they don't look forward to your expectations, they don't look forward to your happiness, they all want you to fulfill their expectations and achieve what they think is reasonable. I used to feel a lot of this, even thinking many times about how to die, is it only when I'm gone that they will think about my efforts, my goodness. Of course now that I'm in front of my screen answering this question, it means that I didn't choose to die, I came through. But I know that desperation intimately. You said you wanted to be sick, and you said, you wanted to go to school, and you said, you wanted to know how you were right. I don't think there's a lot of logic between those ideas. It's hard to say what's right, but wanting to be sick shouldn't be considered very right. Don't you think? So you don't really want to be sick, you just want to be sick so that you can rest, so that you don't have to be so "unintelligent". After all, it's hard to be blamed for something. So, I think you want to be sick as a defense mechanism. When I was being counseled, I saw a scene where I saw a little girl who was standing in an open space, and then a lot of arrows were coming from all directions, densely packed, surrounding her. She was scared and helpless. In desperation, she opened a shield. Covering herself inside, these arrows still leaped around this glass shield, the little girl crouched down, covering her head, not daring to look up. Inside the shield she could no longer hear outside, could no longer be harmed, and yet, she kept shivering. I knew that little girl was myself, and I tried many, many times to approach her, to tell her that I would grow up with her, but she couldn't see me, couldn't hear me. Of course after a long time I am now able to walk up to her and she is willing to believe me and now we are growing together. I want you to know that some of the pain is overwhelming and it can be hard to carry alone. This is the time when I feel the need to lend a hand will make the torment easier. Of course things are already there and it's not easy either way, but as long as you still want to get out, then some of the pain needs to be endured and carried. Let me give you a couple pieces of advice. First, if you are ready, you can find a counselor, preferably one with a background in psychoanalysis or humanistic training. Of course family therapy would be better. Second, don't blame yourself. In all the past, you did everything you could to protect yourself. Although, the result is still not so good now, it is not your fault. Third, don't blame your family. They may not have considered your feelings, but they probably didn't mean to hurt you, and they have their own limitations, a lot of things they can't see, a lot of things they can't do. Fourth, express your feelings. Tell your family directly what you feel most directly, such as aggression, pain. Try to express them in a quiet state. Let the past pass so that the future can come. Cheer up! Hopefully, my answer will give you a glimmer of warmth.

question: What is wrong with a 20 year old female who has always had a tendency to overeat off and on for the last year?

Behind overeating, shopping, and so on, there is a hidden heart that has not been fully satisfied and cared for. Please think back to when you were a child, did your parents give you enough love and companionship? Were your parents able to meet your normal material and emotional needs in a timely manner? Did your parents always praise you or criticize you? As a matter of fact, if the needs of the child are not met, the seed of "scarcity" will be planted in the child's mind. Some children's material needs are not met because of family circumstances; some children's emotional and companionship needs are not met because their parents are too busy at work or work outside the home. These unmet needs will remain in the child's heart until he grows up. What he did not get as a child, he will ask for from his surroundings when he grows up. If the child does not receive enough love and attention as a child, the child will grow up to ask for love from people around him, especially his partner, and hope to receive attention from his partner all the time, and if he does not receive attention, he will feel especially anxious because he is "not loved anymore. Face your heart. Take a moment and hug yourself for the times when you may not have gotten enough attention, love and care. Look straight inside yourself and ask yourself what you want most, what you want most, or what are the things you want but haven't gotten yet. We can't change the past, but what we can do is to satisfy our own hearts from here and now. Loving yourself is the fundamental way to heal everything. Take care of yourself emotionally and physically, make peace with yourself, make peace with your past, make peace with your family of origin. Try to encourage yourself, satisfy yourself, and please yourself. You will find that you grow up and mature a lot when you can live a full and happy life without relying on the strength of others. Being able to face life and life itself independently is the most empowering manifestation of you. So, behind overeating is the problem of needs. Once the problem of need is solved, naturally you will not overeat. There is no need for you to be anxious and worried or to blame yourself because, it is not your fault. Loving yourself and caring for yourself is the fundamental way out of the problem. Hope this helps, good luck!

question: Can a counselor see into the heart of another person's mind?
description: In the image of many people: counselors have a deep gaze and can see through the inner thoughts of others. Therefore, many people stay away from counselors, fearing that they are transparent in front of them. Can a counselor know what's going on in the mind of another person?

answers.answer_text: The answer is no. Many people think that a counselor is a deep thinker who can see right through you. However, this is not true. Counselors do not have such supernormal capabilities. Many people have questions when they hear this: Since you don't know what I think, how can you help me? Even if I tell you lies, you don't know, so how can you carry out your work? Visitors who come for counseling come to the counselor with problems. Most visitors want the counselor to provide a once-and-for-all solution that will solve the problem. The truth is that counselors don't do that, nor can they. The counselor usually guides the visitor to recognize the source of the problem, search for the root cause of his or her own inner conflict, so that the visitor can grow and explore ways to solve the problem. This process of growth and exploration is not easy, but rather painful. Therefore, the process of counseling is essentially a process in which the counselor guides the visitor in the process of self-exploration. The key to the solution still lies in the visitor. According to foreign survey statistics: in judging the success rate of lies, psychological counselors and police, personnel and other professionals about the same, only a little higher than ordinary people. Visitors spend the consultation fee to do counseling, if he does not cooperate with the counselor, intentionally tell lies with the counselor, want to test the counselor, then the counseling will lose the meaning of existence, the loss is the visitor.

On the other hand, your mother's era, life experiences, and age are different from yours, so it's normal to have different perspectives on things. I don't think people of the same generation as your mother would have the exact same opinions on these issues either. It would be a problem if you completely accepted everything your mother said. Based on the way you describe the problem, it seems like your frustration doesn't stem from not listening to your mother's advice, but rather from the emotional distress caused by her advice: disturbing your peace of mind and making you feel angry and torn. Here are a few possible reasons for this, as reference: feeling controlled by your mother, which makes you feel restrained and unable to act freely, obviously this would make you feel unhappy; feeling guilty for not listening to your mother, Chinese culture values filial piety and obedience, and obedience is often demonstrated by listening to one's parents; perhaps your mother has had a special significance and made sacrifices during your upbringing, which undoubtedly increases your guilt. Feeling like not listening to your mother's advice is an attack on her, hurting her, seems a bit like repaying kindness with ingratitude, a complete defiance of what is right. This may also be related to your age. People in their twenties or thirties are often unwilling to listen to others, especially people they are familiar with, giving input or criticizing them. Such actions are seen as denying oneself. The body's strong physique, confidence, and abundant energy do not allow them to believe that they are inferior or being criticized. If this familiar person has always held an advantageous position that suppressed you, then you would be even more "enraged". Under the influence of these forces, how can "my heart not be disturbed, not be torn, and not be angry"? Try to express your inner feelings to your mother when she continues to advise you. If you can't say it out loud, you can express it in writing. I also feel that "you know how to speak and how to control yourself!" Tell your mother: understand her desire to protect and guide you throughout your life, understand that everything she does is for your own good, wanting you to take fewer detours and experience less hardship. question: What if you want to do a lot of things and feel like you never have enough time?
description: What if there is never enough time? There are so many things you want to do and so little you have time to do.

answers.answer_text: Time is the fairest of all for all of us, and everyone only has 24 hours in a day. How to make the best use of time, so that you can get more out of the limited time, you need some skills to manage time. Feeling that you don't have enough time is because you want to do a lot of things, but you don't think clearly about what you want to do, you don't have a purpose and plan, thus creating confusion and not knowing how to start. Therefore, the most effective way is to use time management tools to sort things out: ● Method 1: four quadrant method 1, take out a piece of paper, the things you want to do one by one list. 2, you list these things to be categorized, divided into what is important need to be done first, what is secondary can be arranged later. 3, using the "four quadrant method 3, using the "four quadrant method" to put these things into four grids, respectively: important & urgent, important & non-urgent, urgent & unimportant, non-urgent & unimportant. The first three are the things you need to arrange to do first, arrange the big part of your time here, and the rest can be done with fragmented time. Method 2: Project List Method 1: Every morning, make a list of things you want to do that day. Be careful, don't be too greedy, just list 3~5 items. If there are too many items, it will be beyond your time and ability to complete, but instead will cause stress and anxiety for you.2. Think about the time period when you are most efficient and energetic in doing things. Schedule the most important items on your list for this time period. Put a check mark when you finish one item to give yourself a sense of accomplishment.3. Every night before you go to bed, you can review and recap the completion of the list of items for that day, and then preset the list for the next day. ● Method 3: The Goal Method 1. Find a time to sit down and think about what your goal is. What are the things to be accomplished to reach the goal?2. Break down the goal events, break down the steps, and list the plan. Then according to the plan. 3, the development of the goal plan needs to be within their own time conditions and capabilities. There is a SMART principle can be referred to: ① S - Specific (specific), the content of the plan should be as specific as possible. ② M - Measurable (measurable), the effect of the program can be quantified and measured. ③ A - Attainable (achievable), the content of the plan after your efforts can be achieved, not beyond their ability. ④R--Relevant (Relevant), the plan must have relevance and continuity with other target programs. ⑤T--Time-based (time-bound), the implementation of the plan must have a certain time period, in which to complete. These are a few basic time management tips, I hope they are useful to you. The last thing to emphasize is that every minute of our time is precious, so don't just waste it. Chunks of time can be scheduled for important things, but some fragmented time should not be ignored and can be utilized for something just as well. Some things are precisely through the daily use of fragmented time to carry out, little by little, day by day to accumulate, such as memorizing 10 words a day, reading a book for 20 minutes, reading 1 knowledge article ...... will eventually have unimaginable gains. Cheer up!

question: What do you do when you're 18 and can't stop self-harming?

Recommended that you read a book: "from self-criticism in the liberation", I think, you now need to come out of self-criticism, put your high standards down, do not push yourself too tight. You set high standards for yourself and what do you worry about? You feel that if you don't hold yourself to a strict standard, you won't be recognized or liked, right? However, you have to realize that no matter how good you are, you can't be recognized by everyone. Just take a look at the entertainment circle, no matter how beautiful and talented a star is, no matter how many people follow him, there will always be some people who do not like him, and even hate him. This is even more true for us ordinary people, some people will like us, and some will hate us, and sometimes it's not even our own problem, others will have their own prejudices, and dislike you for no reason at all. Therefore, there is no need to push yourself too hard, it is good to have a pursuit, but we should also live within our means, and also pay attention to the combination of labor and relaxation. You can't stop self-harming, so maybe self-harm has become a way for you to vent your emotions and punish yourself. You can try to vent your emotions in a healthier way, such as talking it out, shouting it out, writing it out, crying it out, and exercise will also have a good effect. What works for each person may be different, so take your time at first and find what works best for you. Hugs to you, the world and I love you! (^_-).

question: How can you stop striving for perfection when you set your own expectations so high all the time?
description: I am a very high demand for themselves, the pursuit of perfection, came to work in a new environment, I would have been very introverted and timid, but I hate to everyone like me, and I have a very good relationship with me, and I play, but I seldom take the initiative, so and around the relationship with the colleagues in general, nothing very good, but I always hope that all the people and I have a very good relationship, so the requirements of the high, can not reach, very low self-esteem, always feel that I always feel bad about myself. How can I not be so demanding of myself and pursue perfection?

answers.answer_text: One of the keys to not demanding so much of yourself and not striving for perfection is accepting yourself. I also hear you say that when high expectations are not met, you have low self-esteem and feel bad about yourself. Now I want to ask, how would you describe yourself? Can you see yourself as a whole person, with your unique traits, strengths, and areas that need to grow and change? Do you accept yourself as less than perfect, or do you feel that I am only acceptable if I don't have those bad parts? The truth is, we can be less than perfect. The imperfect us is just as worthy of being loved. So when you do accept yourself, you will not be so demanding of yourself, or of others, and you will not be so much in search of perfection. But it's a process that takes time.

That is to say that the emotion (C) that you think that you have been hurt by your friend and that you feel sad inside is not directly triggered by what she has done (A), but is most importantly influenced by your thoughts, interpretations and evaluations of the event. First of all, as a mother, we should first find the reason why the child goes to school crying, there may be the following points: (1) can not adapt to the life of the first grade, because the promotion to the first grade is going to be a big gap with the kindergarten. The first grade pays more attention to learning, behavioral norms, as well as discipline, these and kindergarten life has changed; (2) whether the school and classmates get along well, just entered the first grade daughter, classmates have changed, whether it is because there is no children in the class can play together, then began to rely on her mother more? (3) It is also possible that this is what is known as separation anxiety, which is when a child who has lived with her family for a long period of time is unable to adapt to a sudden departure and begins to cry, not wanting to leave her family. In view of the above, I hope the following suggestions can help you: (1) You can ask the teacher about your child's recent situation at school, whether there is any discomfort at other times, plus your own observation to understand your daughter's situation. (2) When the child is going to school, parents should encourage the child to walk into the school full of anger, for example, before parting, gently embrace the child, and say to him, "Go on, the children are waiting there for you to play together!" When you go home and accompany your child to bed, you can ask her to tell you what she has experienced every day. (3) At night when she goes to bed, mothers can give their daughters company and tell her stories with meaning, so that she can understand from the stories that she has grown up, that her mother and father can't be with her all the time, and that she needs to grow up on her own. (4) As mothers, when we send our children to school, we can tell her when mom will pick you up, and we can occasionally take a little time to visit her at noon, but we must tell her in advance that you have to be strong and that mom will do what she says she will do, so that her child will be psychologically prepared in advance. As a mother, it's really hard, once again, give you a hug. I hope the above helps the subject in some way. Good luck!

Hugs to the subject: from the question, I can feel the mom's concern for the child and her anxiety of not being able to be with the child. When the child just started the first grade, the mother always accompanied the child to sleep at noon, but due to work, the mother could not go home at noon, and the child always cried and did not want to leave the mother in the face of the new environment. Whenever mom was not home at noon, the child wiped her tears and was very sad. Seeing such a situation, the mother is very distressed, but there is no way to come back to accompany the child, the anxiety adds a few more points. In first grade, the child leaves kindergarten and has just entered a new environment. Just like this mom: it is still very important to pay attention to the management of your child's emotions! It is important to make sure that your child adapts quickly to the learning environment as well as developing study habits so that he can adapt more quickly to elementary school. Your child's anxiety may have a lot to do with the new learning environment. So mom may want to spend more time with her child. In fact, the quality of time spent with your child is more important than the time spent with him. If the quality of companionship is not high, even if full-time at home, the child still face the parents cold face, I am afraid that the effect is not as good as a short period of time to accompany, high-quality coexistence is much better. When you get home in the evening, you can talk to your child more about school life. Talk about her daily academic life and her relationships with her classmates. See if there are any things that make him feel disturbed. Parents can advise her and unblock her emotions, so that they can become their child's confidant. When the child isn't bothered too much, she will focus more on the important things. Parents also need to relax and not let their anxiety affect their child. Emotions can sometimes be contagious, just like when you first separate from your child in kindergarten. Children are actually far better at dealing with emotions than parents remember. Many children cry and scream in front of their parents, but when the parents actually turn away, the child instead has a great time in kindergarten with their buddies, forgetting about the anxiety they felt when they were separated from their parents. So for this matter of anxiety, parents should not intentionally strengthen it first of all, look down, the child will be easier to adapt to the rhythm of life. In addition, for the cell phone thing also do not need to force to the child. In fact, there is data to prove that the length of time playing on the cell phone is directly proportional to the growth of anxiety, so use your cell phone with caution.

Hi subject, I saw your description of the conflict and ambiguity in emotional communication between yourself and your girlfriend. From your analysis, it is clear that you want to work with your girlfriend to maintain the relationship, and you want to be a role model so that your relationship can have more positive emotions, less unhappiness, and make life better. All of this shows that you are very responsible. In relationships, having disagreements and arguments are common and an opportunity to promote mutual understanding and communication. How do you go about resolving these ambiguities and conflicts so that your relationship can heat up? The first thing to understand is that there really is no right or wrong in a relationship, and you both don't need to be right or wrong. We've all heard the saying: don't reason in a relationship. This is because in relationships, people's thinking is often driven by emotion rather than reason. You seem to be expressing "how to do this thing", but in fact you are saying "I desire you to take care of me a little more", the latter is the real emotional appeal, is hidden under the rational description. Expressing "I want to ......" is better than expressing "you should ......" to let the other person know that it is not her "fault". "It's not her fault", it's something she can "give". When she asks why you are unhappy, you can also answer directly, for you, what makes you feel unhappy? What do you want her to do so that you can be happier? And whether or not she understands that she has to take care of her boyfriend's feelings is something she has to think about and weigh. The distinction here is important, and when it's clear, it allows both of you to stop being opposites and become one, one willing to fulfill and take care of each other. This way you are both presenting needs that can be faced together, rather than conflicting ambiguities. You can try it ~ good luck and sauce.

【Let's talk about some feelings】Hello, I see your words and feel your worry and anxiety, as well as frustration. Building a relationship between two people is truly a learning process. Let's take a look at your case together.【First】Different thoughts: "Female inner feelings: Guess: I have my own personality traits, and so do you. We are the best for each other. Through thick and thin, the small problems that arise can gradually be overlooked. It doesn't have to be too complicated in a relationship or in a future marriage. All these ups and downs are normal. Male inner feelings: As people, we need to learn and have role models. In the future, our lives should improve together, reducing unhappiness and moodiness. I lead by example and hope you can correspond to these feelings." These two passages show your differences. The female perspective believes that individuals should have their own personalities and quirks. You can tolerate me, and I believe you can overlook my faults. This is just the way I am. The male perspective believes that people should grow and mature. I have already tolerated you, but it seems like you can't feel it. That's why you began lecturing.【Second】Father-daughter interaction: "It's all my fault for always preaching first. Then my girlfriend responds with a series of questions: Why don't you open up and talk about it? How would I know if you don't tell me? Are you saying all this in the hope that I will change? Why do I need to conform?" I want to ask why you lecture her. Do you trust your girlfriend? Do you see her as an adult rather than a child? Do you believe she is capable of fulfilling her responsibilities as an adult? When do we lecture someone? I don't think you are capable of doing this, or perhaps you don't truly believe that she can become the ideal person you envision. So, you want to change her. Treating her like a child to be educated and imposing your own beliefs and values onto her. There are no boundaries and no trust between you.【Third】The negative consequences of maintaining this manner of interaction: The more we treat each other like children and the less we believe in each other's potential for growth, the more she will exhibit childish behavior and resist personal development.【Fourth】Returning the responsibility of growth to the other person, changing the way we communicate: If your partner's behavior makes you uncomfortable, you need to clarify why you feel that way. Is it because her actions go against your preferences? Or does this situation have an impact on you? If it's about not liking her behavior, then you are labeling her actions and making negative judgments about her. However, this evaluation is only a personal label and holds no significance for her. So, no matter what you say, it's just your personal opinion, and she won't be able to take it in. If her actions have an impact on you, such as slamming the door making you feel scared, you can honestly express it. When you slammed the door, I felt scared, upset, hurt, and disrespected... Use your own feelings instead of lecturing.【Fifth】Respecting each other's limits and boundaries: After listening to the other person's words, whether they choose to change or have the ability to change is within their own boundaries and limitations. We should express understanding and respect. If you cannot accept it, please respect your own feelings and boundaries.【Sixth】Respecting each other's differences: When two different people are together, there will inevitably be some different opinions and perspectives. If we insist on transforming the other person into the image we desire, it will be meaningless and only lead to feelings of frustration.【Seventh】Appreciating each other's similarities: When we have been in a relationship with someone for a long time, it is easy to forget why we liked them in the first place. When we appreciate the other person's virtues, we are actually recognizing our own strengths. Talking about feelings is a breakthrough in the original Chinese way of life. Chinese people like to have their own insights, but expressing emotions and feelings like Westerners is not something that can be achieved overnight. Traditional Chinese personalities tend to be introverted and not good at expressing immediate feelings. Only through practice can this be improved. In interpersonal relationships, expressing emotions and vulnerability is more meaningful than expressing opinions and judging right or wrong. Best wishes to you, namaste!

It feels like the subject was blindsided by his girlfriend's question, right? When you are exploring a relationship issue that is ambiguous, and the conversation is overwhelmed by mutual negativity, and you feel that the communication is not going anywhere, then try to interrupt so that you both can take a break and resume the discussion. After the interruption, try compromising. Compromise is based on the foundation of accepting your spouse's influence, and in a healthy and happy intimate relationship, you can't keep insisting on getting your own way, no matter how right you feel you are, because that's just your own perspective and it's not fair to the other person. Compromise is not about giving up your point of view and insisting on it, it's about seeking common ground. Or switching your thinking to set the rules not to ask why, but how? After all, our brains are designed to solve problems, not create them. Asking what to do is looking for ways to solve the problems faced. One of the first things we need to understand about relationships between men and women is that there is a common difference between men and women all over the world: men are used to focusing on the problem itself, while women focus on the emotional expression and feelings. Generally speaking, women are more open to the influence of their other half, while men are more inclined to protect their power from being shared, which is helpful in the workplace, but a hindrance in the life of a lover. In an intimate relationship, the more carefully you listen to the other person and take her feelings into account, the more you can find a solution to some conflicting issues, and the solution is buried in understanding. If it's a problem that can be solved with a word, a hug, or a look, don't make a big deal out of fighting and getting angry. Questioner, are you right?

Hello friend, based on your description and previous questions, I personally feel that there is a lack of communication in the "language of love" between you and your girlfriend. It is well-known that in order for people to communicate effectively, there must be a mutual understanding of the language. Otherwise, if you speak English and I speak Chinese, we would not be able to communicate at all. The same applies to relationships between boyfriends and girlfriends, as each person has their own "love language" that must be understood and shared in order to have a successful relationship. From your description, when your girlfriend "suspected she was pregnant," you believed that joking and laughing with her was a way to show your love because you thought it would bring joy and happiness to her. In summary, "joking and laughing" is your "love language". However, your girlfriend sees it differently. She views pregnancy as a significant event in life that involves the possibility of marriage, starting a family, and major life changes. She is faced with various uncertainties, and in such moments, she hopes that you can "understand" and "comfort" her, as that is what she perceives as love. Your tendency to "joke and laugh" about this matter only makes her feel like you do not care about her and only prioritize your own enjoyment. In her perspective, "care" is her "love language". Therefore, learning how to bridge the gap in your "love languages" is a lesson the two of you need to undertake. Additionally, you mentioned that things that are obvious should not be brought up because it is not beneficial for either party. It is clear that you are more concerned about the outcome of bringing up certain topics. However, for women, during the process of communication, they often care more about the ability to "communicate" with you itself, rather than the benefits that may come after. This is because during the process of "communicating", their emotions are released and it serves as a means of emotional adjustment for them. This is also why women enjoy "chatting" so much. Therefore, it would be helpful for you to learn more about "women's psychology" when you have the opportunity.

From your description, you can see that because your parents always blame yourself without thinking, and make yourself feel sad and aggravated, and can not understand whether such behavior will have a negative impact on yourself. The answer is yes. When confronted with parents who do not know how to deal with their own emotions, the child may feel afraid and worried. If the parents take out their emotions on themselves, they feel bad but may not dare to fight back or be unable to do so, and keep suppressing their emotions, becoming timid and cowering. It may be that in getting along with others, they may feel guilty because of the bad emotions of others, and they may think whether it is some of their behaviors that make others feel emotions, and they cannot adapt well to the interpersonal environment. At the same time, parents are their children's first teachers. Seeing their parents handle emotions in this way, children may be conflicted, i.e., on the one hand, they know that this way of handling emotions is going to cause others to be hurt. On the other hand, they may think that if their parents are like this, why can't they be like this themselves; or they may have a subtle influence on their children, making their children's ability to regulate their emotions poor as well. You need to communicate well with your parents, express your feelings clearly, and tell them that they need to deal with their emotions instead of taking their temper out on you. In addition, pay attention to regulating the way you respond to your emotions, you may also unconsciously release your emotions on others, so reflect diligently and consciously manage your emotions, you can utilize deep breathing or record your emotions to relax yourself before responding to the problem calmly. It's not over yet, this is a plan, we also need to write down an implementation intention, what is the reason? The reason is because there is a bottleneck in our cognitive ability called "working memory". You can think of the algorithmic mind as a computer, and working memory is its memory. It determines the upper limit of our reading speed, attention span, and all other cognitive abilities. The capacity of working memory is very small, but there are so many things we have to do every day that it is difficult for a small working memory to handle so many things at the same time. Therefore, when we write down the plan "I want to take care of the children", the brain will think that since this thing does not need to be executed immediately, it does not need to take up our valuable working memory: and the act of planning is over, the brain will throw the plan into deep memory, which is a kind of self-protection mechanism of the brain, but in this way, it will be very difficult to retrieve this task in the future. would have a very hard time trying to extract this task in the future. So what if we need to write down the intention to execute and think of the plan as a future event? Think about it, if you're catching up on a series and it updates every Tuesday night, by the time Tuesday rolls around, you'll naturally remember to watch the show, you don't need to be reminded. answers.answer_text: Hello owner! Very understand your mood and feelings, sometimes really make people feel helpless ah. "Because the two people are not together, I can feel that he is particularly insecure and possessive, I can give him" sense of security this topic is very large, including a very large number of things, from a broad perspective, the organism's self-preservation instincts is one of the greatest sense of security, narrow sense of security, including personal safety, as well as emotional security. . An important reason for a person's insecurity lies in his or her intimate relationships, and the family of origin, which is the first and most important intimate relationship for all people, most of the time fails to perform as expected. The interaction with the family of origin has a very strong influence on the person, and if the relationship is mostly characterized by happiness, contentment and joy, then the probability is that these will become a major theme in the person's life. On the other hand, if the relationship is characterized by disappointment, sadness and fear, the probability is that the person's life will be filled with negativity and insecurity. Security is difficult to give, because it is a subjective feeling, rather than an objective, real existence, that is to say, it is no standard, or its standard is not operable. Is it possible for two people to be together 24 hours a day, 365 days a year? For people who are extremely insecure, not seeing each other for a second may cause this kind of uneasiness, so unilateral giving and fulfillment cannot fundamentally solve this problem. "I have a very calm and talked about the future of the two of us, but he is very excited every time, yelling and crying, I really can not stand," this situation is already a more serious "regression". As an adult male, in the face of similar emotional problems, emotional excitement, yelling, crying, obviously is not normal. What are the views and perceptions behind his strong emotions that we need to explore and address further. Girl, I believe you love each other and I believe you are sincere to each other. But if you really want to try to fix his "psychological problem" (let's call it a psychological problem for now) as much as possible through an intimate relationship, it's not an easy thing to do, and you need to be prepared for the fact that it will take more than time and patience for you. In this case, I still recommend receiving psychological counseling, but the premise is that he is willing to, after all, psychological counseling is to help people help themselves, if the visitor does not take the initiative to adjust and change the willingness, then the effect of counseling will be greatly reduced. I wish you a happy life!

If your boyfriend doesn't have the will to change, it's really hard to change what you have. We say no one can wake up someone who is pretending to be asleep. From the description, I can feel that your boyfriend needs intimacy. Although we have short contact with many people every day, it is still not enough for us. People need intimacy because intimacy is different from ordinary human interaction, intimacy can satisfy our need to belong. So what is the need to belong? In American psychologist Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs theory, the need to belong is the third level after physiological needs and safety needs, which maintains our inner peace and is a kind of instinct for us human beings. In other words, our happiness depends largely on how much our belongingness needs are satisfied. In order to fulfill the need to belong, we strive to establish and maintain intimate relationships with others. Once we have a crisis in our intimate relationship, we will be soulful and prone to think of bad things, which will alienate the relationship between two people. It's really hard to deal with a boyfriend who lacks a sense of belonging and is not willing to change himself, like the subject boyfriend, but there are two ways to go about it, the first one is to stay away from him and circumvent all the conflict, then chances are you can get a relatively peaceful relationship, but it's not an intimate one. The other way is to really realize that in relationships, true harmony comes from emotional maturity. So the specific situation is that one of them, just one of them decides, I want to grow up. And when you take full responsibility for the growth of your relationship, your intimacy takes a step forward. So now that one person has taken a step forward, what about the other person? That person (your boyfriend) will either take a conscious step forward as well, or sooner or later your relationship will end as well. So most of the time, when one of the partners actually takes responsibility for growth, the other will eventually follow their partner's lead. But at the end of the day, it all starts when one of the people in an intimate relationship starts taking responsibility for their own growth, not just for the relationship alone.

question: I'm 23 and my boyfriend has been set up on a blind date, is it still possible for us?

Recently he was arranged by the family blind date, the family also know my existence, just do not quite believe in long-distance. Although I understand that he may not have the initiative too much to listen to the words of the family, in the future, even if the two of us may also be subject to his family will not be happy. But I'm just not willing is angry, can not believe that so gentle and beautiful people actually have no way to make their own decisions, why he has been working, economic independence, but still do not have the right to insist on choosing their favorite people to decide what they want to do in the future will be swayed, I still have the opportunity to change him? I'm going to graduate school this year, set a deadline for myself, and would like to ask whether it is still worth it to wait for him to grow up.

answers.answer_text: I'm afraid the hardest thing in the world is to change someone else, and there's no guarantee that you'll be able to change him for sure, and your time is precious, so why not spend it on something more worthwhile, with someone more worthwhile to give it to? Whatever the boyfriend's reasons are, he's now made the decision to break up with you, he's putting the rest of his life above you, he'd rather listen to his family and go on a blind date with someone else than try again, fight it, and try to be with you. He made his choice, and the answer is pretty obvious to me, he obviously doesn't care enough about you. How do you know that he was just pressured by his family? Maybe he thought all the reasons his family analyzed for him made sense, so he chose to give up even after his own thinking. Maybe what you should be most worried about is not that you will be subjected to his family in the future, but that he can't take responsibility for his own life like an adult, he can't even stand up for the people he loves, will such a man be like a time bomb in his life? About [anxiety] Appropriate anxiety is actually necessary for people. Without anxiety, there would be no source of motivation for self-growth. Then go a little bit to dissolve these complexes, then as a result of the complexes, this anxiety will also naturally lower. 2., about [panic] you said you see cancer inexplicable panic, and the fear of losing their partners. Panic about illness can be seen as a fear of death to some extent. Everyone has a fear of death, and at some point in time it will suddenly appear or intensify because of something that stimulates it. For example, illness, passing away of a loved one or friend, etc. Seeing one's fear of death and facing it up is really difficult, as existentialist Irving Aron said, "It's like looking directly into the blazing sun with your naked eye, you just can't hold on to it for very long." But also Aron says, "Facing death head-on is not a matter of opening a troubling Pandora's box, but of returning to life in a richer, more compassionate way." So the fear of cancer may be leading one to see the fear of death that you ignored or couldn't face before, and if it can be faced with courage, then a different insight can be gained. The fear of losing your partner seems to be followed by a fear of being alone after losing your relationship. If your current relationship with your partner is stable and your partner is healthy, then it may be insecurity imprinted from earlier experiences that is behind your fear. If you are yourself experiencing less secure relationships as well as illnesses, then again this part of the fear can be evoked. To prevent bad things from happening, go ahead and envision bad things happening, which is itself a defense against bad things that might happen. How to do this is really a cliché: face it and accept it. In Mr. Zeng Qifeng's words: try to "separate the past from the present, and separate yourself from others." 3, about the past, the present, the future you say you can not live in the present, either in the past or in the future. This is actually one of the anxieties that people have about [existence]. Maybe the present moment has some pain and hard feelings for you that you can't bear, so the subconscious mind makes you either stop in the past or live in the future in order to make you feel better. Maybe stopping in the past and living in the future may not be so pleasant. But it is at least better than the present. And so a cycle of indulgence is created, where the harder it is in the present, the more you go back to the past and the future; and then the present becomes harder and harder. Over and over again this cycle goes on. How to change. In terms of action, meditating and watching the breath and meditating are the most effective ways to pull us back to the present moment in a short period of time. Maybe try it for a while on a consistent basis. Back to the psychological level, that is, to sincerely face our past, present, and then, the future will be rewritten. Still in the words of Mr. Zeng Qifeng, the goal of psychotherapy is to maximize the elimination of the influence of the past on a person and to help a person live better in the present. The above is my answer. Good luck!

Then explore your needs, ask yourself "what do I need to do" and take steps to fulfill your needs, such as having dinner with your partner, etc. Once you start to feel good, it means you are better able to solve your problems. The reason this works is that it's impossible for a person to be in two emotional states at the same time, so once you're in humor or entertainment mode, it's natural to drive away anxiety, anger or fear and enter a state of calm. Hello building owner! Here are a few ways to introduce you to relaxation training, I hope it can help you. It is an exercise process to make the organism relax from the state of tension. Relaxation has two meanings, one is to say that the muscles are relaxed, and the other is to say that the tension is eliminated. The direct purpose of relaxation training is to relax the muscles, and the ultimate goal is to reduce the activity level of the whole organism to achieve psychological relaxation, so that the organism can maintain the balance and stability of the internal environment. The basic requirements of relaxation training are: in a quiet environment, the practitioner should be in a stable mood, attention focused, muscle relaxation. In the practice, attention should be paid to the gradual and orderly progress, relaxation training speed should be slow. When relaxing a certain part of the muscles, it is important to allow sufficient time for the subject to experience the relaxation sensation. First, breathing relaxation method We can first exercise our clear awareness and consciousness of their own breathing condition. Because we are using abdominal breathing when lying down, you can lie down to experience.　　　　1, to wear comfortable loose clothing, maintain a comfortable lying posture, feet to the sides of the natural open, one arm on the upper abdomen, the other arm naturally placed on the side of the body.　　　　2、Breathe slowly through your nostrils, feeling the inhaled gas a little cooler and the exhaled breath a little warmer. After a few minutes, sit up straight, put one hand on your belly and the other on your chest, notice the movement of both hands during the inhalation and exhalation, and determine which hand is more active. If the movement of the hand on the chest is more pronounced than that of the other hand, this means that we are using more chest breathing than abdominal breathing. We need to improve abdominal breathing.　　Second, muscle relaxation method: The muscle relaxation method achieves relaxation by making a person consciously feel the tension and relaxation of major muscle groups. You try this feeling: make your right hand into a fist, clench it tighter and tighter, then feel the tension in your hand and forearm, and let this feeling go into your fingers, palm and forearm. Then relax your hand and notice the difference in sensation between tension and relaxation. You can do this again with your eyes closed, realizing that tension, and then relaxing again, letting the tension flow away.1. Sit or lie down in either position and let the whole person be in a state of relaxation.2. Focus your attention on your breathing, adjusting the rhythm of your breath and keeping it even and rhythmic.3. Begin to visualize the relaxation of every muscle from your head, neck, chest, shoulders, back, waist, abdomen, legs, and finally your toes. Feelings, this feeling is like a melting candle slowly melting, starting from the head has been relaxing to the toes, and finally relaxed as if the whole person is paralyzed to the ground, how a candle melted comprehensively that feeling. Third, the mood relaxation method is in your anxiety or emotional ups and downs are relatively large when you can try to do the following things: 1. transfer emotions. That is, you should quickly turn your attention to other aspects. For example, sometimes run into things that do not go well or quarrel with relatives at home, may wish to temporarily leave the scene, a change of environment, or with others to go to Kanye, or participate in some cultural and sports activities, entertainment. This will soon dilute the original bad mood to drive away, and regain the mood of peace and stability.　　　　2. Longing for the future. The pursuit of a better future is human nature, but also human survival and social progress. Only often look forward to a better future, in order to always maintain the spirit of progress. No matter where fate throws itself, should be calm. No matter how cruel the reality, should always believe that the difficulties are about to overcome, the dawn is ahead, believe that the future will be better.　　　　3. Speak to others. Said also has the symbolism of the oral sex period, when the mood is not happy, you can talk to friends, which need to learn to make friends first. This is a way of expressing yourself in a way that relieves your emotions, not just through eating.　　　　4. Broaden interests. Interest is an important condition to protect a good mental state. The broader the interests of a person, the stronger the adaptability, the less psychological pressure. For example, you can read books, writing, creative writing, painting, playing the piano, sword dance, raising birds, fishing, planting flowers and so on. In short, the broader the interests, the richer, fuller and more energetic the life, the easier it is to keep yourself relaxed.　　.
